Too many families in North Carolina are getting hammered by rising power bills, forced to worry that their lights might turn off if they come up short at the end of the month.
I've heard from folks like John, a dad and small business owner in Black Mountain whose utility bills have skyrocketed over the past few months. His bill has more than doubled in the last two years, and between his small business and home's utilities, he's being hit by rising energy bills on all sides.
And John isn't alone. Families all across the state are facing rising prices, and they're already fighting to make every dollar count. It's not right, and it's time for a change.
As Governor and Attorney General, I put aside party politics to fight utility cost increases for North Carolinians. I vetoed a Senate Bill that prioritized higher profits for utility companies over more cost-effective energy solutions. And I battled Duke Energy in court to get their profit margin lowered.
I also directed more than $50 million in federal funding to strengthen North Carolina's power grid, bringing cheaper and more reliable electricity to the state.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f1d05e5b-3d12-407c-ad78-8aa754267c93?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/47a7bfd4-3263-4234-b467-955b840d3c15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I will take to Washington those same commitments I made as Governor and Attorney General. Here's my plan:
One main challenge right now is the current strain on our power grid. Data center and tech companies use massive amounts of electricity that can increase the costs for consumers. And that's just not fair.
The companies that build these data centers must pull their own weight, pay for the power they use and completely remove this burden from North Carolina families and small businesses. We must encourage companies that build data centers to also build their own power sources, which will help reduce utility costs for consumers.
It's also clear that too much of our power grid is old and out of date. Technology is evolving quickly, and we must take this opportunity to modernize our systems. If we properly update our power grids, we can lower costs for families and create good-paying jobs at the same time.
Folks throughout the state know how important effective and reliable utilities are, especially during extreme weather conditions. I spent time in 15 western North Carolina counties after Hurricane Helene hit and saw how dangerous it was to lose power. We must protect North Carolinians when they are most vulnerable, and that starts with banning utility companies from disconnecting power during dangerous heat, cold or other extreme weather.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/47a7bfd4-3263-4234-b467-955b840d3c15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And on top of that, Duke Energy recently announced their fourth consecutive rate increase in four years. At first, they wanted to increase your electric rates up to 18%. That proposal was unacceptable, and they faced such strong public scrutiny that they were forced to reconsider. I am grateful that so many people stepped up and told Duke Energy that this increase was plain wrong. Because of you, they've lowered the rate hike to 11.6%.
But that is still too high. Most residents in the state rely on Duke Energy for their utilities and are forced to bear the burden of these rising costs.
It's unacceptable. I have consistently stood up to utility companies -- like Duke Energy -- and fought to lower utility costs for North Carolinians. As major utility companies choose to line their own pockets over the needs of consumers, I have repeatedly fought against every rate hike or unfair policy.
Meanwhile, when my opponent was a lobbyist in DC, he argued in favor of rate increases for utility companies like Duke. He has cheered on the economic agenda coming out of Washington that's making life harder and more expensive for working families while making life better for the billionaires and big corporations. Michael Whatley spent years representing the interests of utility companies like Duke Energy, and he still owns stock in their company. So as people like John struggle to afford their energy bills, Michael Whatley profits.
That's not the kind of Senator I will be. I will put the people of North Carolina first. Before politics, before the party, before power.
I'm ready to be an independent voice for North Carolina, focused on the stuff that really matters to people. Whether you can [chip in](https://substack.com/redirect/47a7bfd4-3263-4234-b467-955b840d3c15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a few dollars, [volunteer](https://substack.com/redirect/57845ee3-de01-46ce-aeb4-60f0cdb9ed06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to knock doors or just stay updated on this race, every effort counts. We are building a critical movement of volunteers that's working hard every day until Election Day to fight for North Carolina.
Thank you.

And on top of that, Duke Energy recently announced their fourth consecutive rate increase in four years. At first, they wanted to increase your electric rates up to 18%. That proposal was unacceptable, and they faced such strong public scrutiny that they were forced to reconsider. I am grateful that so many people stepped up and told Duke Energy that this increase was plain wrong. Because of you, they've lowered the rate hike to 11.6%. But that is still too high. Most residents in the state rely on Duke Energy for their utilities and are forced to bear the burden of these rising costs. It's unacceptable. I have consistently stood up to utility companies -- like Duke Energy -- and fought to lower utility costs for North Carolinians. As major utility companies choose to line their own pockets over the needs of consumers, I have repeatedly fought against every rate hike or unfair policy. Meanwhile, when my opponent was a lobbyist in DC, he argued in favor of rate increases for utility companies like Duke. He has cheered on the economic agenda coming out of Washington that's making life harder and more expensive for working families while making life better for the billionaires and big corporations. Michael Whatley spent years representing the interests of utility companies like Duke Energy, and he still owns stock in their company. So as people like John struggle to afford their energy bills, Michael Whatley profits. That's not the kind of Senator I will be. I will put the people of North Carolina first. Before politics, before the party, before power. I'm ready to be an independent voice for North Carolina, focused on the stuff that really matters to people. Whether you can a few dollars, to knock doors or just stay updated on this race, every effort counts. We are building a critical movement of volunteers that's working hard every day until Election Day to fight for North Carolina. Thank you. | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Roy Cooper PO Box 1190, Raleigh, NC 27602 ? ?

| | | | | | Good morning!**With 100% of the precincts reporting, I received over 71% of the vote for a decisive victory on Tuesday.** Thank you to everyone who donated, endorsed, helped, volunteered, and of course, **VOTED** for me to return to the State Senate! 🙌With the primary behind us and only a short time between now and when early ballots for the November election are mailed, we have a lot of work to do to hold this Senate seat.**Will you join me in this next battle to save our legislature?** The national Democrat Party has been organizing and raising money in a very serious way to flip our legislature to blue. They sent a large investment to the Arizona Democrat party earlier this year to help increase voter registration numbers and help with their get out the vote efforts.**It is well-known Governor Katie Hobbs and Democrats are stockpiling resources to flip the legislature to Democrat control.** If this happens, there will be a major policy shift in Arizona. We would emulate California if we lose control of our state legislature pretty fast. As a swing district legislator and committee chair, I have made sure their agenda hasn’t seen the light of day.**We need your help to keep our Republican majority in the state legislature.** Republicans have continued to set the agenda in the current divided government. The majority party sets the legislative policy agenda, chooses leadership in each chamber, and selects committee chairs. I have chaired the Senate Committee on Regulatory Affairs and Government Efficiency for the past two years.**You can help today by volunteering with our campaign or making a donation to help us build the ground game needed to defeat the Democrats in November.** Here’s how you can help us: Volunteer your time
Write postcards
Knock on doors
Put up a yard sign
Make a contribution
If you would like to volunteer for our campaign, please let us know by [emailing me](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=volunteer&body=). If you live in LD2 and would like to request a yard sign, please request one [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/17JWIed182m?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211).We have a fundraiser coming up on August 5th from 4pm to 6pm. Please RSVP [HERE](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=RSVP%20for%208%2F5%20fundraiser&body=).Together, we can hold the legislature, protect Arizona values, and stop California-style policies. **We will need all hands on deck and a united team to win.** Thank you for your continued support.Take care,Shawnna

Shackle devolving, explosive chaos.
Drag it, writhing and collapsing,
into the steely exam room,
fluorescence penetrating every vice.
Lash it to the table.
Ignore its bellowing indignation.
Sanitize your hands for relentless probing
and snap rubber to avoid contamination.
Take up your glittering precision blade.
Slice with nerveless fingers through
the outer skin of calamity,
and begin.
Crimson confidence,
Laced with life-giving complacency,
Spatters as you pierce a layer of blindness.
Icily stripped away, that unmasks
Bundles of idealistic nerves,
Demanding irrational objectives
Of the brute muscular power of ignorance.
This disastrous contraption
Runs on fairy tales ravenously devoured,
And bedecks deep-hidden bones - hubris.
Finally, your cold fingers
arrive at the base heart -
immortal arrogance
and deadly ambition.
Surgically, you detach it for exhibition,
holding it high to appease
the feral world,
to ameliorate the anarchy,
to drown the offspring of a fiasco.
_Written by 13-year-old Melissa Chaudhry, circa 2005, two years into the Iraq War._

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: We cannot let this happen in New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260723_1.urmvyJ&refcode=em20260723-1&t=1&akid=7890%2E582294%2Ea93-Qr)
I know what it’s like to run against a Republican with high name ID and a national donor network behind him — I’ve done it before. And I won.
Now, Chris Pappas is facing the same kind of threat in New Hampshire. Donald Trump has personally endorsed former Senator John Sununu in this race — and the latest polling shows this race is a complete tie.
Look, in order for Democrats to take back the Senate majority and put an end to Trump’s unchecked power, winning in New Hampshire is absolutely critical.
**[That’s why I’m in this fight with everything I’ve got. And why I’m asking you to please pitch in $5 right now to help Chris Pappas stand up to big-money Republicans, compete against John Sununu, and keep this seat blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260723_1.urmvyJ&refcode=em20260723-1&t=2&akid=7890%2E582294%2Ea93-Qr)**
**[Donate $5 to support Chris Pappas »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260723_1.Ir0KFe&refcode=em20260723-1&t=3&akid=7890%2E582294%2Ea93-Qr)**
Chris is a Granite Stater through and through. He’s not in this for power or prestige or to cozy up to billionaires. _He’s in it to make life better for working families — the folks who get up every day, work hard, and are struggling to get by._ He’s fought Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, stood up for veterans, and protected reproductive rights when they’ve been under relentless attack.
Chris Pappas fights for the people — not the wealthy and well-connected. He shows up, he listens, and he gets things done. That’s what New Hampshire needs, and it’s what working people across the country need.
**But Republicans know New Hampshire is one of their best shots at flipping a Senate seat this year.** Sununu has the name recognition, the right-wing billionaire network, and the full weight of the national GOP behind him.
We’ve seen this before. Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire.
**If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful —[then I’m asking you to please chip in to Chris’s campaign now to help him compete and win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260723_1.urmvyJ&refcode=em20260723-1&t=4&akid=7890%2E582294%2Ea93-Qr)**
I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire. If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful — I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

subject: TONIGHT: Join me and Cori Bush at our 50th Birthday Roast, a virtual fundraiser for our re-election campaigns
disclaimer_text:

Sisters Saving Lives
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Tomorrow, I’m turning 50 years old — and a few days ago, my ally Cori Bush
turned 50.

TONIGHT we’re celebrating our birthdays together and raising money for the
final few weeks before our primary elections!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141143?t=1002&akid=38070%2E1203867%2Ezh5jRp ]Please use this link to RSVP and join us tonight at 8 pm ET for our
virtual fundraiser and 50th Birthday Roast.

Donations will go toward Sisters Saving Lives, our joint fundraising
committee that splits donations evenly between our two election campaigns.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141143?t=1003&akid=38070%2E1203867%2Ezh5jRp ]Flyer that reads: Sisters Saving Lives 50th Birthday Roast for Cori
Bush and Rashida Tlaib. Virtual Fundraiser July 23, 8pm EST. Paid for by
Sisters Saving Lives.

We’ll get roasted by guest speakers and we’ll talk about what we’ll fight
for in Congress if we get re-elected.

My sister-in-service Cori was the first activist in the movement for Black
lives to serve in Congress, where she led the fight against police
brutality and repression.

I’ve been proud to support her leadership in the fight for Black and
Palestinian liberation, housing and utilities for all, reproductive
justice, and a national public safety system that centers care rather than
punishment.

I recently joined her to knock doors and raise money for her campaign in
St. Louis:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141143?t=1004&akid=38070%2E1203867%2Ezh5jRp ]Photo of Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib

Together we’re fighting for a government that invests in our communities’
urgent needs rather than spending our tax dollars on state violence.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/141143?t=1005&akid=38070%2E1203867%2Ezh5jRp ]Please use this link to RSVP and join us for tonight’s virtual 50th
Birthday Roast and fundraiser to send me and Cori Bush back to Congress!

RSVP FOR TONIGHT

Thank you for working alongside us for the country we all deserve, where
our tax dollars go toward helping everyone thrive rather than war crimes
or corporate profits.

See you tonight!

Rashida

body:

Dear Peter,
I'm honored to have earned the endorsements of the Vermont Teamsters Local 597 and the Vermont State Employees' Association.
These endorsements mean so much to me personally. My husband has been a proud Teamster for more than 20 years, and I've seen firsthand what a strong union means for a family. Unions don't just negotiate better wages and benefits. They create dignity and security.
That's why I've always believed that if you work hard, you should be able to support your family, care for the people you love, and retire with dignity. That’s why I stood up for Vermonter’s pensions as Lt. Governor in 2022. That’s why I'll stand shoulder to shoulder again with Vermont workers if reelected.
Across our state, working people are organizing and standing together. Here are a few ways you can show your support today:
🏥 Stand with UVMMC workers
Hospital workers are fighting against cuts and for Common Good Bargaining that benefits all Vermonters.
Sign the petition : https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/tell-uvm-health-our-community-stands-together?source=direct_link [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/tell-uvm-health-our-community-stands-together?source=direct_link]
🗳️ Volunteer for Proposition 3
Help protect workers and strengthen Vermont's future.
Get involved : https://yeson3vt.org/ [https://yeson3vt.org/]
👶 Save birthing services in Brattleboro
Support families by protecting essential maternity care at Brattleboro Memorial Hospital.
Sign the petition : https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/save-essential-birthing-services-at-brattleboro-memorial-hospital [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/save-essential-birthing-services-at-brattleboro-memorial-hospital]
💙 Support Community Health Center workers
After management announced plans to lay off two-thirds of the billing department while outsourcing work to an out-of-state company, workers are calling for transparency, collaboration with the union, an end to unnecessary outsourcing, representation on the CHC Board, and support for universal health care.
Add your name : https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/stop-the-cuts-prioritize-patient-care [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/stop-the-cuts-prioritize-patient-care]
Every one of these fights is about the same thing: ensuring that working people are heard and working families can thrive.
Our campaign is building real momentum because of union members, grassroots organizers, and supporters like you. I'll never stop fighting alongside Vermont's working families, and I hope to continue that work as your next Lieutenant Governor.
Will you chip in today to help us win this race and elect a Lieutenant Governor who will always stand with workers and defend the right to organize? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mrg2026-em]
If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process now.

Thank you for standing with Vermont workers.
In solidarity,
Molly Gray

# [Miami crushes New York again in return-to-office rankings](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Miami ranked No. 1 in Placer.ai's Office Index for June 2026 with estimated office visits surpassing 2019 levels, **[leading the nation in return-to-office recovery for five of the last six months while New York ranked second.](https://substack.com/redirect/df2f36e9-1145-4d9a-bce1-b081c8d35a26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

---|---|---
* **Office attendance leadership:** Miami secured the top nationwide spot for post-pandemic return-to-office recovery in five of the last six months according to recent Placer.ai monthly data.
* **Corporate footprint expansion:** Companies including Amazon, Blackstone, IRU and Simpro Group expanded commercial presence in Miami since initial market entry after 2020 arrivals.
* **IRU rapid growth example:** Tech firm IRU grew from a small Coconut Grove sublease to more than 25 times its original footprint in under two years after naming Miami East Coast headquarters.

# [Early Alzheimer's diagnosis now gives patients a real fighting chance](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Guy Benson **[revealed](https://substack.com/redirect/1cbc4d34-f68a-4703-abf9-cb9b0abd011f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** his mother has battled Alzheimer's for years **[while hosting Dr. Brent Beasley,](https://substack.com/redirect/bd6f0614-4701-4a5a-99b4-7034cf3b932f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** diagnosed with early-onset at 57, on advancements that helped five patients slow the disease via anti-amyloid treatments after early diagnosis.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Personal family motivation:** Benson publicly shared his mother's multi-year **[fight with the cruel disease](https://substack.com/redirect/0b6fcda1-065a-40e4-a690-fc261e9d5914?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for the first time, making medical science and public policy responses a personal point of emphasis.
* **Treatment restores function:** Five patients including Beasley regained independence, church roles, marathon running, family memories and daily routines after early access to anti-amyloid therapies that slow progression.
* **National priority needed:** Patients call for early diagnosis as a national priority through blood tests, primary care empowerment, caregiver support and ending Medicare and insurance barriers to treatments.
* **Awareness month commitment:** An estimated 7 million Americans live with Alzheimer's as a **[2025 presidential message recommitted to research,](https://substack.com/redirect/7d453491-ed34-431b-a747-57bbde3667ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** innovation and system reforms to prevent, treat and cure it.

# [The obesity drug with 22% weight loss is heading to FDA in 2027](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Eli Lilly **[will file for approval of its next-generation obesity drug Retatrutide](https://substack.com/redirect/adfab3ee-239e-4744-b8c7-621cc2f4e2ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the first quarter of 2027 after the weekly injection succeeded in two more late-stage trials showing major weight loss.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Phase three results:** Adults with obesity and Type 2 diabetes lost up to an average of 20.8% of their weight or nearly 50 pounds at 80 weeks on retatrutide.
* **Cardiovascular trial outcomes:** Adults with severe obesity and established cardiovascular disease lost up to an average of 22.6% of their weight or 55.8 pounds at 80 weeks.
* **Side effects consistent:** The most common side effects across the trials were diarrhea, nausea and constipation matching those seen in the broader GLP-1 drug class.
* **Triple hormone targeting:** Retatrutide targets GLP-1, GIP and glucagon hormones for more potent appetite effects than existing treatments like tirzepatide or semaglutide.

# [Moonshot AI got banned Nvidia chips despite Trump's export rules](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A White House official accused Chinese AI company Moonshot of accessing Nvidia advanced chips to train its new Kimi K3 model **[despite U.S. export controls banning the technology.](https://substack.com/redirect/7f6dbded-e070-4e2d-8957-c21865877f30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Chip access allegation:** Michael Kratsios stated Moonshot acquired GB300-equipped servers and accessed GB300s in Thailand, likely to train its AI models released last week.
* **Model performance claims:** Kimi K3 with 2.8 trillion parameters closes the gap with frontier models including Anthropic's Fable 5 and OpenAI's GPT 5.6 Sol, surpassing some benchmarks.
* **Distillation claims raised:** Kratsios also said Moonshot distilled Anthropic's Fable for K3 development, echoing earlier industrial-scale extraction claims against advanced models.
* **Sanctions threat issued:** Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent threatened sanctions and Entity List designations for Chinese firms conducting covert distillation attacks that cross into IP theft.

# [Bessent: We found the Ayatollah's money man and froze millions](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the administration has tracked down the Iranian ayatollah's money man and **[plans to publicly expose more than $100 million in linked properties around the world.](https://substack.com/redirect/eb316f49-caa4-4ab4-942c-7e232fb1056f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Economic Fury campaign:** The effort forms part of a broader pressure campaign aimed at dismantling the regime's financial network by tracking overseas assets and freezing accounts after recent military operations.
* **Currency and inflation impact:** Iran's currency sits at an all-time low versus the dollar in freefall while inflation runs upwards of 180% inside the country according to Bessent.
* **Oil revenue pressure:** Chinese purchases of Iranian crude have dropped roughly 40% amid sanctions on teapot refineries, intensifying financial strain on the regime's funding sources.
* **Resource preservation goal:** Officials aim to recover and preserve the assets for the Iranian people once the pressure campaign concludes on the other side of current efforts.

# [The elite BlackRock-Google-Ford-Carhartt alliance betting on skilled trades over degrees](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
BlackRock, Carhartt, Ford and Google **[announced the Alliance for America's Skilled Trades](https://substack.com/redirect/2254477d-b797-47ca-9ec5-298a8c2466b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to expand workforce training and address growing shortages of electrical workers, technicians and builders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Apprenticeship investment focus:** The alliance intends to work with labor unions and trade associations while investing in apprenticeship programs and raising awareness of pathways into the skilled trades.
* **Shortage drivers identified:** Experienced workers aging out of the workforce has produced more job openings and higher pay for electricians, HVAC technicians, plumbers and builders across the country.
* **Education enrollment shifts:** Undergraduate certificate and associate degree program enrollments both grew by about 2% in fall 2025 while bachelor's degree enrollment rose by less than 1%.
* **Infrastructure demand cited:** Ruth Porat of Google said building physical infrastructure for America's future requires significantly increasing the skilled tradespeople pipeline through collective action.

# [Cracker Barrel is dumping Maple Street Biscuit Co. and shutting 16 sites](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Cracker Barrel sold Maple Street Biscuit Company assets tied to 35 locations to Biscuit Belly LLC and will close the remaining 16 restaurants while **[completing a sale-leaseback of 26 sites for roughly $77 million.](https://substack.com/redirect/0e8aa505-5930-49a0-b100-a6ae05b5b8e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b70de361-b2d7-4709-92d3-5011c500ef51?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Debt reduction focus:** The sale-leaseback of 26 company-owned locations generated roughly $77 million in net proceeds that Cracker Barrel plans to use to pay down debt while continuing to operate the sites.
* **Buyer expansion plans:** Biscuit Belly, currently with 15 locations, will convert the acquired Maple Street restaurants into its brand over the next 18 to 24 months starting in Cincinnati and Richmond.
* **Financial charges expected:** Cracker Barrel anticipates recording between $37 million and $39 million in non-cash charges plus $6 million to $8 million in additional cash costs tied to the Maple Street exit.
* **Core brand sharpening:** Maple Street accounted for less than 2% of annual revenue and the divestiture is expected to improve adjusted EBITDA beginning in fiscal 2027 according to CEO Julie Masino.

name: Rocky Adkins
subject: A fight I’d wage again and again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rocky for Kentucky
body:
Teachers can always count on me.

| |
---
Dear Peter,

If you've been following Kentucky politics for a while, you may remember one of the biggest and proudest fights of my career: standing up for Kentucky’s teachers. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135858295/635558462/993225892?amount=25&refcode=20260722_RA_FR_LAUNCH_4&refcode2=af200323-bc86-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MjEwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjIwMDMyMy1iYzg2LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nOFhrTAJ_cmJRS5lEz_ZcxlkoNs2kFvJBUinaleUdiM=) In 2018, Republican Governor Matt Bevin came after the pensions that Kentucky teachers had earned over a lifetime of service.

Thousands of educators flooded the Capitol to make their voices heard. I didn’t watch from my office or send in a staffer to represent me.**I stood with them in solidarity because I believe a promise made needs to be a promise kept.**

[**This mentality will be what I bring to the governor’s office if I have the honor of serving. If you want a governor who can fight and keep a promise, I hope you will be by my side during this campaign.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135858296/635558463/993225892?amount=25&refcode=20260722_RA_FR_LAUNCH_4&refcode2=af200323-bc86-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MjEwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjIwMDMyMy1iYzg2LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=nOFhrTAJ_cmJRS5lEz_ZcxlkoNs2kFvJBUinaleUdiM=)

Public education is in my blood. My father spent 50 years in public education, my mom taught preschool, and I myself got my start in the classroom.

When teachers, public employees, and our public schools came under attack, we took that fight head-on. And with a fair ruling from the Kentucky Supreme Court, we won.

Matt Bevin left office in disgrace, largely because of his foolishness with Kentucky teachers, and Governor Beshear and I made sure that our teachers knew we were on their side throughout his entire administration.

I thought about that fight as I weighed my options about how to serve next. We’ve already seen what happens when the governor’s office falls into the wrong hands. We've seen attacks on public schools. On teachers. On workers. On retirement security, people worked hard for decades to earn. We've seen leaders pick fights _with_ Kentuckians instead of fighting for them.

That's why this race matters.

**The governor of Kentucky isn't just another elected office. It's often the last line of defense between bad policies and Kentucky families.** I've seen that firsthand serving alongside Governor Beshear these last six and a half years. When harmful ideas came out of Washington or Frankfort, we fought to protect Kentucky.

Now I'm asking for the chance to keep doing that work.

subject: Greg Abbott won't tell you this
body:
Abbott's biggest donors are profiting while rural communities pay the price.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Greg Abbott wants Texans to believe he's finally standing up to the data center boom.
**I don't buy it** — and neither do the Texans I've been meeting with across the Panhandle.
After spending the weekend listening to farmers, ranchers, and rural families whose communities are being transformed by massive AI data centers, one thing became clear: _they're tired of politicians making promises while powerful interests call the shots._
That's why I said it plainly: **No one believes the arsonist will put out the fire.**
Greg Abbott helped create this crisis. Now, as election season approaches, he's trying to distance himself from the very industry his biggest donors are profiting from.
**His self-imposed deadline for state agencies to recommend protections for Texans has already come and gone — with no public action to show for it.**
Meanwhile, some of Abbott's biggest campaign donors are investing heavily in the same data center boom that's driving up electricity demand, **threatening** rural communities, and putting even more strain on our electric grid.
Texans deserve better than empty promises.
I believe the people, not billionaire donors or AI companies, should decide the future of our communities.
That's why I've been traveling across Texas, meeting directly with the people most affected and fighting for real accountability instead of political theater.
But taking on Greg Abbott and the powerful interests funding his campaign won't be easy.

DEAR FRIENDS,

Our campaign is picking up real momentum, and I'm grateful for all of you who are standing with us.

This Friday I'll be at the Blessing of the Fleet race, a great local tradition full of community spirit and celebration. I'm
looking forward to being there with you.

I've also been out meeting even more local business owners across Congressional District 2. These conversations are eye-opening.
Small business owners are the backbone of our economy, and they're telling me the real challenges they face every day. We need to
create a welcoming job environment that helps them grow and hire more Rhode Islanders.

On July 16, URI Economist Len Lardaro released his latest analysis of Rhode Island's economy. He noted that if our labor force
participation rate were back to pre-pandemic levels, June's unemployment rate would be 7.7%. He averages the numbers and estimates
the actual rate is around 5.9%. That's still too high, and it shows we're not moving in the right direction. For far too long,
Rhode Islanders have been stuck with "do nothing" politicians when it comes to encouraging real investment in our state. But that
changes with me.

President Trump has received well over $18 trillion in commitments from companies and countries into the United States. I'm going
to fight hard to capture our fair share of those commitments for Rhode Island's workers and bring good-paying manufacturing jobs
back home.

I'm also continuing to build strong contacts in Cuba as President Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio work to open new
opportunities. Leveraging long-standing friendships with Cuban-American associations in Florida, I've traveled on humanitarian
missions to Cuba. The relationships I'm building with religious and civic leaders will help put Rhode Island first when that
island nation opens its doors and begins buying the goods and equipment its people need. Rhode Island manufacturers can provide
motors, gaskets, refurbished engines, food stuffs, medical equipment, and many other products that Cubans will need. The key is
being at the front of the line when President Trump says "all clear."

In the past, when the United States opened trade relationships with other countries, the American jobs went there. Rhode Island
lost whole industries — textiles, jewelry, Leviton, Bulova, Speidel, Coro, Gorham Silver, and more. Our state lost 41,000
good-paying manufacturing jobs after NAFTA and the China WTO agreements were signed. I want to make sure that isn't the case for
Rhode Island this time. I will work hard and long to make sure our workers are the ones who get the jobs and Rhode Island's
economy is the beneficiary.

We have a real chance to turn things around. Let's put Rhode Island first, protect the American Dream, and make sure our state
finally starts winning again.

Sincerely,

Vic Mellor

Candidate for Congress, Rhode Island's 2nd District

clean_body: [] DEAR FRIENDS, Our campaign is picking up real momentum, and I'm grateful for all of you who are standing with us. This Friday I'll be at the Blessing of the Fleet race, a great local tradition full of community spirit and celebration. I'm looking forward to being there with you. I've also been out meeting even more local business owners across Congressional District 2. These conversations are eye-opening. Small business owners are the backbone of our economy, and they're telling me the real challenges they face every day. We need to create a welcoming job environment that helps them grow and hire more Rhode Islanders. On July 16, URI Economist Len Lardaro released his latest analysis of Rhode Island's economy. He noted that if our labor force participation rate were back to pre-pandemic levels, June's unemployment rate would be 7.7%. He averages the numbers and estimates the actual rate is around 5.9%. That's still too high, and it shows we're not moving in the right direction. For far too long, Rhode Islanders have been stuck with "do nothing" politicians when it comes to encouraging real investment in our state. But that changes with me. President Trump has received well over $18 trillion in commitments from companies and countries into the United States. I'm going to fight hard to capture our fair share of those commitments for Rhode Island's workers and bring good-paying manufacturing jobs back home. I'm also continuing to build strong contacts in Cuba as President Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio work to open new opportunities. Leveraging long-standing friendships with Cuban-American associations in Florida, I've traveled on humanitarian missions to Cuba. The relationships I'm building with religious and civic leaders will help put Rhode Island first when that island nation opens its doors and begins buying the goods and equipment its people need. Rhode Island manufacturers can provide motors, gaskets, refurbished engines, food stuffs, medical equipment, and many other products that Cubans will need. The key is being at the front of the line when President Trump says "all clear." In the past, when the United States opened trade relationships with other countries, the American jobs went there. Rhode Island lost whole industries — textiles, jewelry, Leviton, Bulova, Speidel, Coro, Gorham Silver, and more. Our state lost 41,000 good-paying manufacturing jobs after NAFTA and the China WTO agreements were signed. I want to make sure that isn't the case for Rhode Island this time. I will work hard and long to make sure our workers are the ones who get the jobs and Rhode Island's economy is the beneficiary. We have a real chance to turn things around. Let's put Rhode Island first, protect the American Dream, and make sure our state finally starts winning again. Sincerely, Vic Mellor Candidate for Congress, Rhode Island's 2nd District [] [] [] [] [] [] [] Want to change how you receive these emails?

Most of them scattered. The few who stayed had no real answers. Why the panic? Because California Democrats are fast-tracking AB 2624 -- already being called the " Stop Nick Shirley Act." This bill would make it a crime for citizen journalists like Nick to film or post videos of publicly funded facilities -- exactly the kind of on-the-ground investigative work Nick has been doing in California and Minnesota. If this bill passes, Nick's ability to expose taxpayer fraud in government programs could be severely crippled -- or even criminalized -- with fines up to $10,000 and forced content removal. Think about what that means: Nick's explosive Minnesota daycare fraud investigation that forced Congress to take notice? His on-the-ground reporting in California exposing waste and abuse in government programs? Future investigations into hospice fraud, voter roll issues, or any other taxpayer-funded facility? All of it could be criminalized under this new law. The message from Sacramento Democrats is crystal clear: " Stop exposing the fraud... **or we 'll make sure you can't." And the ultimate irony? The same lawmakers who authored and voted to advance this bill watched Nick Shirley walk right up to them in their own Capitol building, microphone in hand, and ask them point-blank why they're trying to criminalize investigative journalism. They had no good answer. That 's why Lincoln Media Foundation exists -- and why we're asking for your help again today. LMF is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that directly funds independent journalists like Nick Shirley. We cover the real costs of his work -- travel, filming, editing, distribution, and security -- so he can keep investigating stories the mainstream media refuses to touch. _Crime scene of prosecutor Alexandra Bravo 's and her sister, Olinda Bravo's assassination. Photo provided to Drop Site News by Radio Pichincha._
_[Para leer esta historia en español, haga clic aqui.](https://substack.com/redirect/a0d80c9f-2cef-44f2-aa53-83686a36b247?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
QUITO, Ecuador--Alexandra Bravo, the prosecutor assigned to investigate U.S. strikes on three Ecuadorian boats and the 36 survivors' subsequent accounts of torture and kidnapping, was shot dead in the coastal city of Manta last month. According to police, on June 14 a hitman aboard a black motorcycle opened fire on Bravo as she and her sister were leaving a cafe at about 11 a.m. Bravo's sister, who jumped to protect her, was also killed in the attack.
Upon arriving at the crime scene, officers say they found five 9mm shell casings and Bravo's injured driver, but no sign of the police detail that had been assigned to protect her. The Police Directorate, which operates entirely under the executive branch, has launched a probe to determine if there'd been an internal security breach.
Bravo is the 26th member of Ecuador's justice system to be assassinated since 2020 and the [second individual investigating state crimes murdered that week](https://substack.com/redirect/a3fe7eac-c03c-418d-81d0-299b0340a3f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Besides her usual caseload of homicide and organized crime, Bravo had been working the Fiorella, Negra Francisca, and Don Maca cases--[a series of drone attacks on civilian fishing ships exposed by Drop Site in April](https://substack.com/redirect/dc47dae0-c673-4397-9fb6-2877bd284e6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Two of the boat's crews returned home and reported being abducted, blindfolded, and starved for eight days by American gunmen in U.S. military uniforms aboard a U.S.-flagged patrol ship, before being abandoned in El Salvador. The UN Committee on Enforced Disappearances endorsed the calls for an investigation, demanding that the U.S. provide information on the whereabouts of the eight still-missing men and any involvement in the matter by April 27. To date, the United States has not responded.
Under Ecuador's right-wing president Daniel Noboa--[a Miami-born billionaire often characterized as a "U.S.-backed dictator"](https://substack.com/redirect/a663e07c-4fa3-473c-aefa-3779e5dc934d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--the country has become a central testing ground for Operation Southern Spear, Washington's extrajudicial bombing campaign purporting to target "narco-terrorists," which has killed 221 people to date. There is no evidence that many of the victims, including those in Bravo's investigation, had engaged in drug trafficking.
"I can't make any assertion regarding it being a political assassination, but evidently, when a prosecutor is killed it's because of the investigation they're conducting," Fernando Bastias, a renowned human rights attorney with Ecuador's CDH and member of the Geneva-based World Organization Against Torture, told Drop Site, "That's something we've learned from our experience in Ecuador."
A source inside the Manta police department, who knew Bravo personally, told Drop Site that the Ecuadorian prosecutor was under pressure from her superiors at the Attorney General's office to treat the U.S. attacks as exclusively "cases of disappearance." The source, who asked for anonymity out of fear of retaliation, said Bravo was told to close all lines of inquiry after 36 of the 44 missing men were found--despite arriving with severe injuries, including 70% vision loss and feet torn to flesh and bone, which medical experts found consistent with their accounts of explosions and torture.
A senior researcher with Human Rights Watch, Nathalye Cotrino Villarreal, who interviewed Bravo as part of her investigation into the three vessels, similarly recalled Bravo facing "internal challenges within the institution itself to advance the investigation." Villarreal said the prosecutor repeatedly sought cooperation from other branches responsible for the ship's rescue, including the Manta Port Captaincy, but "none responded to her requests for information." During the Negra Francisca bombing, Darwin Pico-Flores, an eyewitness aboard a nearby boat, told Drop Site he called the Manta Port Captaincy to request emergency assistance. Nobody came. In April, as part of its first investigation into the incident, Drop Site called the port seeking comment. Officials hung up after learning the call was from journalists.
As of their last meeting on May 8, Cotrino Villarreal told Drop Site, Bravo "was still in the initial stages of inquiry and investigation." Bastias said Bravo "was investigating a country [United States] that has been positioned in the media as an ally against crime. That investigation has not advanced at all, and that stems from an intention to avoid getting into trouble or problems with anyone."
The source inside the Manta Police Department said that, given this lack of cooperation from partner agencies, Bravo had asked for advice on how to pursue new sources for evidence.
In the days leading up to her death, Bravo was relocated to the Attorney General's office in Montecristi, a neighboring municipality. Her caseload changed after the transfer and she was no longer in charge of investigating the three boat attacks. Drop Site attempted to reach Bravo's replacement for comment but he had been explicitly instructed not to speak to the press. After weeks of attempts to reach the Attorney General's office for comment, they told Drop Site the investigation was sealed and they could not comment on why Bravo was relocated.
Inside Ecuador's U.S.-backed military regime,[ the Attorney General's office has become an increasingly opaque and politicized institution](https://substack.com/redirect/7490ec5b-575f-48da-a4a7-33e344330498?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). "It's already a major obstacle for prosecutors to investigate local state agents. Now imagine international state agents," Bastias said. "The Executive Branch has implemented a series of legal frameworks that leave these foreign state agents immune from prosecution," he added, referring to the diplomatic immunity granted to all U.S. military and Department of Defense personnel through President Noboa's 22 martial law decrees.
The Pentagon, Coast Guard, and U.S. Southern Command have all denied any knowledge or responsibility of the boat incidents. After Drop Site published photo evidence of the Negra Francisca bombing, U.S. [lawmakers questioned U.S. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth during a congressional hearing](https://substack.com/redirect/fbc6bd57-a5ff-4197-bcef-2bf3a81ccaef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). On June 13, the day before Bravo's murder, Reps. Joaquin Castro (D-Texas) and Bill Keating (D-Mass.) [published a letter ](https://substack.com/redirect/af2aab2e-aab4-400d-9d45-7ec1f00ade66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to Hegseth, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and Head of the U.S. Coast Guard, Kevin Lunday, [demanding a full audit of U.S. government involvement in the attacks.](https://substack.com/redirect/af2aab2e-aab4-400d-9d45-7ec1f00ade66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Despite the deadline of July 10, none of the agencies have issued a public response. Keating's press secretary Lauren McDermott told Drop Site that his office had received a reply from Rubio's office, but none from the Department of War or Coast Guard. She did not disclose the contents of the response.
The survivors who returned home, and the families of those who didn't, still have not received any answers, telling Drop Site "authorities shut the door in our face." Maria, the wife of one of the fishermen, tells Drop Site her mother-in-law died awaiting her son's return, saying she was struggling with severe depression and stopped in the weeks leading up to her death.
Despite both governments' efforts to stonewall the investigation, evidence continues to emerge supporting the fishermen's accounts of abduction, airstrikes, and torture. Drop Site obtained exclusive video of U.S. Coast Guard activity in the vicinity of the Negra Francisca bombing, open-source intelligence that corroborates the Negra Francisca's testimonies, and police interviews with eyewitnesses that confirm the U.S. involvement alleged by survivors and documented by Drop Site. With the help of Airwars OSINT analyst and former U.S. Marine Corps member Tomi McCluskey, Drop Site accessed additional NASA thermal imagery consistent with the Negra Francisca bombing and vessel tracking data placing U.S. Coast Guard activity along the route the fishermen say they were taken after the strike.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/169a4466-d9d2-4150-9bde-74a807e2b4a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_Video obtained by Drop Site showing alleged Coast Guard activity near the Negra Francisca strike._
## **Political Lawfare Under Ecuador 's U.S.-Backed Military Regime**
Noboa, who governs by military curfews and [mass starvation of political prisoners](https://substack.com/redirect/6d52eeeb-8fcf-4d74-9866-2c0974b3848f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), has gone to great lengths to become Trump's strongest partner in South America. Since taking office, he brushed aside Ecuador's constitutional ban on U.S. military presence--ratified by 60% of voters as recently as November 2025--which was originally introduced [almost 20 years ago](https://substack.com/redirect/77904635-469a-45b5-88df-c2c5f0ad591a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) precisely due to a history of U.S. military sinking boats off the coast of Manta. Additionally, his administration authorized the first FBI office on Ecuadorian soil, assisted a [U.S. Embassy effort](https://substack.com/redirect/d7a590c0-5492-454a-a003-56c48c18c89c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to falsely frame members of Colombia's left-wing government ahead of elections, and collaborated with the U.S. in [the bombing](https://substack.com/redirect/ac2cd881-3748-4126-88ed-1f1e4f6c6ef6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of innocent civilian farmworkers along the Colombian-Ecuadorian border--all in the name of combatting drug trafficking.
Notably, boats from Noboa's [family shipping corporation](https://substack.com/redirect/e716daf1-2411-4f9b-9032-7837e01c96d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were caught trafficking ₤26 million of cocaine--a detail that has not deterred the State Department from naming him a key partner in Trump's War on Drugs. Last month, The Guardian [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/a3fe7eac-c03c-418d-81d0-299b0340a3f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that a whistleblower who was investigating Noboa's ties to drug trafficking was murdered.
Still, Noboa remains a member in good standing of Trump's Shield of the Americas. The Americas Counter Cartel Coalition, as the Shield is also known, functions as both a military and a highly political alliance, having openly intervened to prop up U.S. interests in Bolivia as President Rodrigo Paz faced off with anti-austery protests.
A local prosecutor charging U.S. forces with extrajudicial bombings and torture of Ecuadorian civilians would undermine the alliance and damage Ecuador-U.S. relations.
Other government officials investigating U.S.-Ecuadorian criminal collusion received death threats. Monica Palacios, a National Assembly lawmaker representing Ecuadorians living in the United States, who announced plans to bring the Fiorella boat case before the United Nations, faced months of political lawfare after exposing a U.S.-Ecuadorian government embezzlement scandal. Last Friday,[ Palacios said she received death ](https://substack.com/redirect/ffa1c6a7-817c-47ad-b258-bdec4c7c7f04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)threats against herself and her one-year-old son, along with footage of the outside of her New York home. She directly blamed President Noboa, saying the threats were retaliation for her investigation into U.S.-Ecuadorian corruption.
"There is a direct persecution of judges and prosecutors who, within the scope of their duties, make decisions that are not entirely aligned with what the Executive Branch wants and end up being sanctioned," Bastias, the human rights attorney, said. "On the other hand, there is also the risk stemming from the context of criminality." Regardless, he asserted, Bravo's death "has a lot to do with what the state does or does not do, because so far there haven't been any effective security mechanisms for the justice system's civil servants. The responsibility lies in having failed to ensure protection."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/99249d65-606d-4435-9fdf-5afb6b5a914e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_Alexandra Bravo, prosecutor for Ecuador 's Attorney General's Office, during an interview with Radio San Mateo. Photo provided to Drop Site News by Radio San Mateo._
Diego Vintimilla Jarrin, formerly a lawmaker with Ecuador's National Assembly and now a spokesperson for Ecuador's Communist Party, similarly told Drop Site, "Noboa's government is the most anti-sovereign agenda we have had since the start of democracy. I have no proof of who murdered the prosecutor but the fact that she was investigating certain elements and that they later ceased to seem important also says a lot about the underlying issues."
## **New Evidence Implicating U.S. Emerges**
#### **The Negra Francisca**
The U.S. maintains it never interacted with any of the three boats. A spokesperson for the U.S. Coast Guard told The Guardian that the agency's only involvement in the events was deploying the USCGC Bertholf on a search-and-rescue mission after receiving a MAYDAY alert that the Negra Francisca was on fire, and ultimately found nothing.
But tracking data of the Bertholf's movements, provided exclusively to Drop Site by McCluskey, places the cutter near the Negra Francisca around the time of the bombing before turning off its signal--only to reappear off the shore of Costa Rica the same dates the Negra Francisca crew were taken into Central American waters and transferred to El Salvador's Naval Command, with mangled limbs and major burn injuries from the attack. Hernan Flores, captain of the Negra Francisca, told Drop Site that Salvadoran officers specifically informed him that "U.S. personnel had called to coordinate the handoff."
The Coast Guard denied that it coordinated the handoff. "The Coast Guard did not play any role in the transfer of fishermen from the Negra Francisca Duarte II," said a spokesperson.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/99282fa2-40da-466f-8297-df8171c27b1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_The USCGC Bertholf operating in Costa Rican waters on the same dates (times converted from UTC) that the Negra Francisca crew members were brought to Central America and received by El Salvador 's Navy/Coast Guard. Photo from Global Fishing Watch, provided by OSINT analyst Tomi McCluskey._
The USCGC Bertholf departed the Galapagos military base at 4 p.m. on March 16 and stopped transmitting its location shortly afterwards. A day later, the Negra Francisca was bombed 170 miles away--a distance typically covered by boat in 3 to 10 hours. Drop Site asked the U.S. Coast Guard to account for the cutter's activity after its signal went dark. The Coast Guard responded it "does not disclose cutter movements during law enforcement missions for operational security."
At 1:02 p.m. on March 17, NASA FIRMS registered a thermal anomaly consistent with an explosive fire, corroborating the time and location where Negra Francisca fishermen told Drop Site their ship was set ablaze by multi-drone strikes. The crew say they were then seized at gunpoint by English-speaking men with blond hair dressed in khaki fatigues with American flag patches stitched onto their sleeves--their descriptions match the uniforms pictured in [U.S. Southern Command press releases](https://substack.com/redirect/d0310a93-548d-4c37-b8df-f40b6c1c0945?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Aboard the U.S.-flagged patrol ship, the gunmen allegedly held them hostage, sank their bombed boat, placed hoods over their heads, beat some of the fishermen, and withheld food for eight days as they transported them to Central America.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c81fca1c-2521-4be6-9555-f0e08fbb592b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_OSINT provided to Drop Site by Tomi McCluskey document the USCGC Bertholf 's movements near the Negra Francisca around the time of the bombing (times converted from UTC)._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68334563-b216-4d67-8b24-84faa0e85a1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_OSINT provided to Drop Site by Tomi McCluskey documenting the USCGC Bertholf 's movements near the Negra Francisca around the time of the bombing (times converted from UTC)._
The USCGC Bertholf's signal resurfaced in Costa Rican waters on March 22 near the Golfito Port, approximately 450 nautical miles from El Salvador's waters. It turned off its transponder and did not reactivate it until March 24, 24 hours after El Salvador's Coast Guard publicly announced having had the Negra Francisca fishermen in their custody.
As part of our first investigation, Drop Site reached out to 11 government personnel in El Salvador. All of them refused to go on the record, citing a media gag order.
There is precedent for the Bertholf transferring victims of U.S. airstrikes to Central American authorities, with Costa Rican outlets reporting it delivered the remains of two deceased and one injured survivor to Costa Rica's Port of Golfito around the same time. Costa Rica's nautical inspector Wilber Urroz Guido said he had no information on the cutter's movements but that it was authorized to act under a memorandum of understanding between the U.S. and Costa Rica--similar to agreements the U.S. maintains with Ecuador and El Salvador.
Eyewitness testimony also casts doubt on the U.S. Coast Guard's version of events. Video footage shared exclusively with Drop Site by Darwin Flores-Pico, an eyewitness to the attack and nephew of the Negra Francisca's captain, shows a U.S. Coast Guard cutter patrolling the waters where the bombing occurred.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1975c68b-1fb7-40ef-a2c4-b6b954dec212?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_Video obtained by Drop Site showing alleged Coast Guard activity near the Negra Francisca strike._
Darwin said he was fishing nearby on March 17, aboard his boat the Solavil, when he spotted smoke rising in the distance around 2 p.m. While making repeated attempts to reach the Negra Francisca's crew by radio, he spotted an American aircraft circling above. It wasn't until hours later that he learned by radio signal that the Negra Francisca was in flames and rushed to make his way to the scene, finding the vessel consumed by fire and no sign of survivors.
He recovered two scorched emergency skiffs, took photo evidence of the fire, then called the Port of Manta to ask for help. Nobody came.
Darwin decided to begin his journey back to the port to get emergency assistance and, as he was leaving the scene of the fire, red and green lights descended upon the Negra Francisca. Fearing for his safety, he steered his boat away from the site.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/904338a3-9d92-4300-bcfc-ce72d8b26ccb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_The Negra Francisca burning, photographed and shared with Drop Site by Darwin Pico-Flores._
The following afternoon, Darwin told Drop Site his boat was boarded by the U.S. Coast Guard, which detained and questioned the crew for nearly 12 hours via a Spanish translator with a Puerto Rican accent. He said Coast Guard personnel confirmed the red and green lights were from their patrol and acknowledged reaching the site of the _Negra Francisca_ the previous night, but refused to elaborate on anything they'd found.
Instead, they questioned the fishermen about whether they'd seen anything and why Darwin had salvaged the skiffs. After telling the Coast Guard officials that the Negra Francisca was his uncle's boat, Darwin says they abruptly stopped questioning him and began communicating by radio in English with colleagues aboard the nearby cutter shown in the video. "Since we were the only people who saw everything, we were afraid they might do something to us," Darwin said. He felt the U.S. Coast Guard showed little interest in helping him locate his family and instead seemed more focused on "making sure we weren't witnesses to anything."
McCluskey says the multi-drone tactic--described by all three boats--reflects a U.S. doctrine. He argues it's unlikely that other regional powers, from neighboring countries to organized crime groups, would have the budget or access for such technology. There is no known precedent of cartels using "eye-in-the-sky" surveillance drones deep in maritime territory, though the Coast Guard has also denied operating armed drones in Ecuadorian waters.
Furthermore, the decision to keep the survivors alive, albeit involving testimonies of torture, and the efforts and expenses to transport them, is far more reflective of a Department of Defense protocol---designed to avoid international legal ramifications--than any organized crime group would typically care to practice. "If it was cartels, you would've never found them," McCluskey said. "There would be no survivors to talk to, there would be no stories."
#### **The Fiorella**
The Fiorella was struck off the coast of the Galapagos on January 20; all eight fishermen aboard remain missing. The day before the vessel vanished, the captain's wife received a call from her husband on an emergency line, warning that U.S. aircraft were orbiting overhead.
Drop Site obtained police interview transcripts from two eyewitnesses, Christian Flores and Dimas Ignacio Álvarez, who corroborated seeing the Fiorella engulfed in smoke and surrounded by American assets. The two men were members of the Fiorella crew but had been out setting a long line on a nearby raft for several hours when the vessel went up in smoke.
In their police statements, Flores and Álvarez described two U.S. aircraft flying over the Fiorella on January 18; multiple grey American drones and a U.S.-flagged patrol ship circling the vessel on January 19; and, on January 20--the day their crewmates disappeared--the large U.S.-flagged patrol ship near the smoke. From a distance, they could not make out the personnel aboard the ship, but their accounts echo those of the Negra Francisca crew, who said they were taken hostage by armed Americans aboard a U.S.-flagged patrol vessel. The witnesses' descriptions also match aircraft and equipment featured in public posts by U.S. Southern Command.
Transcripts of police interviews with the eyewitnesses, obtained exclusively by Drop Site News. Originals in Spanish, translated copies in English.
After spotting the smoke, the two fishermen said they heard their crewmates calling the captain over the radio in distress. They were never seen again.
The attorney representing the two survivors of the Fiorella, Juan Avila, told Drop Site that the slain prosecutor, Alexandra Bravo, was in fact his niece.
The Coast Guard told Drop Site it "has no record of involvement with La Fiorella."
## **Bravo Is No Anomaly**
The absence of an assigned police detail when Bravo was murdered bears similarities to the 2023 assassination of frontrunner presidential candidate Fernando Villavicencio. A congressional commission determined that Villavicencio's police detail was insufficient, that he had been unconventionally escorted through an exposed street-level exit contrary to standard protocol, and that the armored vehicle designated to protect Villavicencio on the campaign trail had been left by his security team in another city that day. These breaches made him particularly vulnerable when assailants approached and shot him on the sidewalk as he was leaving a meeting with other government officials.
Villavicencio's death cleared the way for now-President Daniel Noboa's campaign--[which had been polling at 3%](https://substack.com/redirect/cf4a1ba0-c924-4c40-949b-5f5676a6f256?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--to surge to victory. In an interview with Señal Colombia, National Assembly legislator and member of Villavicencio's party, Gisella Molina, who was with him and injured during the assassination, suggested government officials had prior knowledge of the plot.
During the 2024 murder investigation, Drop Site [published](https://substack.com/redirect/7490ec5b-575f-48da-a4a7-33e344330498?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) private messages from then-Attorney General Diana Salazar revealing a plot to implicate former democratic socialist President Correa's party in Villavicencio's assassination, amid close collaboration with the U.S. ambassador.
The state later concluded that the Los Lobos cartel carried out Villavicencio's murder and alleged that former members of Correa's party were the masterminds. Prosecutors assert that Los Lobos killed Villavicencio for exposing their criminal network. While Villavicencio campaigned on eradicating the cartel economy, Ecuador under Noboa--[accused of offering organized crime bosses immunity in exchange for electoral support](https://substack.com/redirect/c8135879-f52e-421f-9a33-8cb4558a1dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--has risen as the top distribution hub for 70% of the world's cocaine.
Immediately following Bravo's death, the Attorney General issued a public statement attributing her murder to retaliation against prosecutors combating organized crime. When asked why authorities had linked the killing to organized crime and whether investigators had uncovered any information about Bravo's missing police protection detail, the Attorney General's office told Drop Site the investigation is under seal and declined to comment.
Though the attorney general has yet to present evidence to support their claim, Bravo lamented to the Human Rights Watch that "danger was always present" in her work. "She said that being a prosecutor in a context of organized crime was complex and risky, but she did not provide any further details," Cotrino Villarreal told Drop Site. Manta sits at the epicenter of Ecuador's organized crime crisis, as the small South American country becomes [the most violent nation](https://substack.com/redirect/42fb7d06-6b4c-48ad-ad37-9a0481083bfa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the Western Hemisphere.
Bravo was also responsible for looking into the unsolved 2024 disappearance of the Patricia Lynn ship and its 21 crew members.
Bravo is the second person associated with the Patricia Lynn case to be assassinated. The first was the mother-in-law of one of the disappeared fishermen who became the spokesperson for the victims' families and organized marches demanding answers for their missing relatives. Maria Choez was fatally shot by two armed assailants while operating her street food stand in downtown Manta.
Cotrino Villarreal says the sinking of the [Patricia Lynn boat ](https://substack.com/redirect/41614440-cb80-41e0-b7d1-1e9ef032413f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)in Ecuadorian waters, "served as a precedent in all these ship-related matters."
"If Ecuador had a framework of trust in its institutions, one might think [Bravo's murder] was an ordinary crime," Vintimilla Jarrin, the former lawmaker, said. "But given the systematic violence against judges, prosecutors, and lawyers, there isn't much room to give them the benefit of the doubt. Twenty-six murdered members of the justice system is a shocking number. And of course, this entire crisis has been fostered by an agenda driven directly by government authorities; the ones who benefit from organized crime are the large power groups."
