body:
When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I prayed my family would be safe...God answered.

[](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDcyM181VS1CMC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NjY2MTctMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA3MjNfNVUtQjAuMTEwMTE3X3QxOTY2NjE3LTI4OTkifQ/of-nDUo5K-GnCqxdbpVeRg)God works in mysterious ways...
When I started my first business, I prayed it would be successful... **God answered.**
When I was deployed to Afghanistan, I prayed my family would be safe... **God answered.**
When I saw career politicians turn their backs on Americans to put their pet projects before the interest of the American people, I prayed for a better outcome...
I was surprised when **_God called on ME_** to run for office.
I'm Troy Downing. You might not recognize my name, but that's okay.
I'm a combat veteran. A God-fearing Christian. A husband & a proud dad.
**[I'm also the Republican running for re-election in Congress for Montana in the biggest race in the country.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDcyM181VS1CMC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NjY2MTctMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA3MjNfNVUtQjAuMTEwMTE3X3QxOTY2NjE3LTI4OTkifQ/XLNv0Wdi6WqukzpDHNB-lg)**
I'm not in this to become a household name or for the title. I don't care about any of that.
I'm a simple man who enjoys a beer, likes to hunt and fish with my buddies & puts my family before anything else.
**__But I'm at my wits' end with two-faced politicians and DC bigwigs who say one thing to your face, only to turn around & stab hard-working folks like you & me in the back.__**
I'll always tell the truth. I'll always put America first. I'll always stand up for what's right.
The Radical Left will spread lies about me & throw me under the bus just to end my campaign before the midterms.
**[Peter, can you take a leap of faith on a simple combat vet like me to beat the Left & save our country?](https://trk.emails.troydowning._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTUwJmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDcyM181VS1CMC4xMTAxMTdfdDE5NjY2MTctMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA3MjNfNVUtQjAuMTEwMTE3X3QxOTY2NjE3LTI4OTkifQ/7HygHMS9YBv3eOM5UGYcTg)**[HELP A COMBAT VET

CBS told Nexstar the money wasn't enough. Hearst stepped up and wrote the check. Now KOAT holds BOTH major networks — ABC and CBS under one roof.

name: Tim Burchett
subject: I had a thought while dunking an Oreo
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Will you chip in the cost of a box of Oreos today and help us defend the House majority?

| [](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._)
---
Washington is full of folks who can turn just about anything into a fancy production.
They love sitting through a three-hour dinner, using six different forks, and eating something the size of a poker chip with a French name nobody can pronounce.
Me? Give me a box of Oreos and a cold glass of milk, and I’m happier than a lobbyist with an open bar.
---
[](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._)
---
You just twist, dunk, and hope the cookie doesn’t break off and sink to the bottom of the glass.
I was doing exactly that yesterday when a thought hit me:
[A box of Oreos costs about five or six bucks these days. That may not go far in Washington, but if a thousand grassroots patriots each pitched in that amount, it would add up faster than the national debt during a Democrat spending spree.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._)
And with the House majority on the line, every one of those small contributions matters. The Left is spending a fortune trying to take back control, stop President Trump’s agenda, and hand the keys right back to the Washington swamp.
So here’s my official ask to you, Peter: [Will you chip in the cost of a box of Oreos today and help us defend the House majority?](https://trk.email.tim-burchett._)

Every election cycle, candidates collectively spend billions of the dollars we gave them on TV ads and to boost their posts on social media. It's a never-ending money pit, and somehow, despite all that spending, working families are still getting crushed by rising costs and our democracy is being eviscerated by corruption and corporate greed.
**More of the same won’t fix this. If we want different results, we have to do things differently.**
That’s why I have invested your money into the nuts-and-bolts of community organizing: yard signs, postcards, walk cards, and a grassroots fellowship program that puts young people out in the community where they can have a lasting positive impact on our democracy.
_(Don’t get me wrong, voters are going to see me and our movement on their televisions, and in their mailboxes, too!)_
**But the most important work starts with centering our politics around people again.**

When we meet people face-to-face, we learn what really matters to them.
We hear from the teacher who has to work two extra jobs just to afford to live in the town she teaches in. We hear from the parent who has to quit their job because they couldn’t make the childcare math work for their family. We hear from the restaurant owner who is being crushed by the weight of skyrocketing food prices.
I’m out in the community every day having real face-to-face conversations with people. Our 1000+ grassroots volunteers are out knocking on doors and canvassing across the district. And our summer fellows are out gaining hands-on experience with grassroots organizing while taking our message to Granite Staters at the same time.

Fellow Patriot,

After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate.

**President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's _"Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate._**

I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, _**but I am ready.**_

I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge.

It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times.

I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for.

I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot.

But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. **[However, I cannot do this alone.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=787e022a1a9c41babd60190f6c1fba3a&_e=jUVVEVnD1SW9BzdH1bly4375V-VHKb3n7n3n2ZDXkQ90dKrrgbd__q62Bv4f-j2LED8P89Y8JQCaGrKiSA6D4vXrhc84nWx9KId0HbbFx1k9oxr374XyDqQA01LuF5bkH8pdTOmAV236C4yUPu29MY08oVZfYpBFZj2M1VTD_2ld3hG8yrIh-GXXOAtMTUwuPFT1jM5Ua8iyfvFz_iUnrfDYY1BOOMwWSGcmsv5DRF-92EygEBQuuUbwaNo6EvO4u_sDn6WBL7nTbEZCe_iUjeEN-YQj6WV4VZIeUdco6PlOkywxl2dwVK3DqpVQHE1iLbvc4TNCOx8KcRZCOQBxvFBSuH_jsADZw2zT4CdKmV_KinuT3MAaQdMDOw6UCsTkYeg519YFAA93WP8g2qbcNw2zwBj-e2USJ4SShfpDjfAYI2U8Rdw8QL52OOQie0ehSqp4vI8mvwecjQE76KoVYsAL1Osa-Jl-XU9Mvc_KJnUQ1E-rV_zYGG55Re4vrQVTRqhnKmw0GIXEMN6tF75oH79tP3sO8hAm-UmIyImTXRQmOtmw96r0cY74wPLEGoh8Wgn3SPfftTH1f5dau-5N8knh9ZK9gnpqv-aDeb_n7ftvW6eOq6e27xtboQYgsI4GaAjUg2lA5Xchry1MpBSAzAeIpTg8eTFIWj4XzwuQ-ZeD5c_vP_E5ixcLkxtZyZynnkmK7TDS5BduORGAKBQ68lYCEZPNa71Z6mec1zWBMI2JkXI0Bo7S8MRGEvHB9TbM)**

clean_body: I'm ready for the fight ahead, and I'm all in to run for the United States Senate. | Fellow Patriot, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Fellow Patriot. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult week. I never thought I'd be in this position, but I am ready to answer the call from President Trump. I am ready to run. | | Paid for by Darline for Senate Don't want to receive any more of our emails? In 2024, Musk spent more than _**$250 million**_ of his personal fortune to help elect Donald Trump. He later bragged about “DOGE’s” efforts to gut programs that provide healthcare and financial security to millions of Americans — all while his own net worth continued to soar.

Now the world’s richest man is pouring money into Republican candidates who are more interested in serving MAGA megadonors than the people they’re running to represent.

Musk has already donated millions to Vivek Ramaswamy, his former “DOGE” co-leader and the Republican candidate for governor of Ohio.

Ramaswamy is exactly the kind of politician Musk wants in power: another wealthy businessman promising sweeping cuts to programs working families rely on — while traveling the state by private jet.

And in Texas, Musk has thrown his support behind Gov. Greg Abbott, whose administration has maintained close ties with Musk and his lobbyists while refusing to fully disclose their communications.

**But EMILYs List women have defeated Musk-funded candidates before, and they’re ready to do it again.**

That’s why we’ve endorsed bold leaders like **Dr. Amy Acton in Ohio** and **Gina Hinojosa in Texas for governor.**

As a physician and public health leader, Amy has spent her career working to keep Ohioans safe and healthy. And Gina has dedicated her life to public service, fighting for the Texas families Greg Abbott has repeatedly left behind.

clean_body: The world’s richest man is back | = Peter, Elon Musk is back. In 2024, Musk spent more than $250 million of his personal fortune to help elect Donald Trump. He later bragged about “DOGE’s” efforts to gut programs that provide healthcare and financial security to millions of Americans — all while his own net worth continued to soar. Now the world’s richest man is pouring money into Republican candidates who are more interested in serving MAGA megadonors than the people they’re running to represent. = | = Musk has already donated millions to Vivek Ramaswamy, his former “DOGE” co-leader and the Republican candidate for governor of Ohio. Ramaswamy is exactly the kind of politician Musk wants in power: another wealthy businessman promising sweeping cuts to programs working families rely on — while traveling the state by private jet. And in Texas, Musk has thrown his support behind Gov. Greg Abbott, whose administration has maintained close ties with Musk and his lobbyists while refusing to fully disclose their communications. But EMILYs List women have defeated Musk-funded candidates before, and they’re ready to do it again. That’s why we’ve endorsed bold leaders like Dr. Amy Acton in Ohio and Gina Hinojosa in Texas for governor. As a physician and public health leader, Amy has spent her career working to keep Ohioans safe and healthy. And Gina has dedicated her life to public service, fighting for the Texas families Greg Abbott has repeatedly left behind. Elon Musk still hasn’t learned that our democracy isn’t for sale. **Muscadine needs water that belongs to the land, not the agency.**
##### **JULY 23, 2026 | THE WAR ROOM | DISPATCH #9**
### **My fellow patriots of District 11, my fellow Floridians, my fellow Americans --**
You do not live on a bureaucrat's schedule.
You reach for the tap to make coffee. Slow drip. The pressure thins. You wait. It does not come back. In Orange County, you know the additional restriction is coming--you just do not know when it lands on you.
Your parents in Sumter County reach to rinse their hands and catch an odor in the water. They do not know what caused it. They had no say in what was allowed near their supply.
Your brother in Lake County reaches to fill a pot for dinner and the pressure drops again. Outside, smoke on the horizon. The water that could have fought that fire was locked up by an agency immune from lawsuit.
Every habit, every instinct, every ordinary motion of life has them reaching for the faucet. And every time, the lesson repeats: the water is not theirs. The tap is not theirs. The well beneath their feet is not theirs. A bureaucrat decided. They comply.
This is the panic that has reached District 11. The families who see it coming are not waiting. They fill the chairs at county commission meetings and city council hearings. They stand up to speak for their water before someone else decides how much of it they are allowed to touch.
They are trying to escape a confiscation that has already begun. In Lake County, 120 acres burned along Wiygul Road in Umatilla--families evacuated, the driest conditions since 1998. In Polk County, Fort Meade approved a 1,300-acre data center over the objections of 40 out of 41 residents who spoke, where the state's own Commerce Secretary called the water estimates woefully underestimated. They are trying to stop it before it reaches their own faucet.
These are not just numbers. These are your families. These are your neighbors. This is what is eating your kitchen table.
### **The Star Chamber The Fourth Branch Will Not Abolish**
The rancher already lives what you fear is coming.
A letter arrives from the EPA. A ditch on his land is now a "water of the United States." His equity vanishes. He appeals--and the only judge who will hear his case works for the agency that took his land. The trap has a price: tens of thousands in legal fees, often more than the land is worth.
The bureaucracy prosecuted. The bureaucracy judged. The establishment looked away. The Fourth Branch built this siege. And when you cannot afford to challenge the agency that took your land, your rights are a luxury you cannot exercise--this is what is eating at the kitchen tables of ranchers in District 11.
### **The Depletion The Fourth Branch Will Not Stop**
The landowner already lives your brother's worry.
The same agency that restricts his well approves a consumption permit for the data center consuming 5 million gallons a day. That water could irrigate the land that feeds your family.
Florida faces its worst drought since 2001. Nearly 2,000 fires have scorched 120,000 acres across the state. In Lake County, 120 acres burned along Wiygul Road--families evacuated, a swamp fire that could burn for weeks. The agency that locked up the water is immune from lawsuit.
The crony consumed. The bureaucracy authorized. The establishment protected. The Fourth Branch built this siege. And when the water is scarce, the bureaucracy decides who gets it and who does not--this is what is eating at the kitchen tables of landowners in District 11.
### **The Sovereignty The Fourth Branch Will Not Restore**
Your parents wonder what is in the water. Florida has the same question--and no power to answer it.
Washington gave Florida authority over its water--then took it back. Your county commission is overridden by the state agency invoking Washington's power. Your property rights do not rest on Florida law. They rest on federal tolerance.
The bureaucracy seized. The establishment surrendered. The crony benefited. The Fourth Branch built this siege. And when your state cannot protect your water, you are a subject of the agency, not a citizen of the state--this is what is eating at the kitchen tables of families in District 11.
### **The Stewardship The Fourth Branch Will Not Let You Keep**
The industry that consumes 5 million gallons a day lobbies for the permits. The Star Chamber grants them. The same system that approves the depletion and authorizes the disposal denies you a real court to challenge either. The President moves to protect your electric bill from data center costs. But who protects your access to the water? The agency that restricts your well and approves their permit answers to no court you can reach. For 15 years, the method was not to dismantle this siege, but to help you survive behind it. They hold press conferences for the algae. They seize your well to protect the aquifer. They treat the symptoms. I strike the root.
### **The Strikes**
Three strikes. One duty: promote the general Welfare.
**Strike One:** The REINS Act. No agency writes a rule that carries the force of law without your representative voting on it. The siege was built by bureaucrats. The demolition begins with your vote.
**Strike Two:** The Administrative Independence Act. When the government denies your loan, restricts your water, or reclassifies your property, you face a jury of your peers--not a bureaucrat protecting the bureaucracy. The star chamber ends. Your rights begin.
**Strike Three:** The Sunshine Mandate. I will question. I will speak. I will expose. Every rule, every rate, every reclassification that transfers your control to those you cannot vote out will face the light. The darkness ends. The mandate begins.
**See the siege. Expose the siege. Tear it down.**
**Strike the root. Secure the table.**
**Vote Palomo on August 18, 2026.**
**Ivette Palomo**
**Farmer. Whistleblower. First Responder.**

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
In just a bit, I'm going on CNN with Jake Tapper — and I wanted you to hear from me first about why.
Today, I'm helping lead a deposition in the House Oversight Committee on the Epstein files. It's one of the most important fights I'm part of in Congress — and before I say another word, I need to ask: Will you chip in $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect more leaders who will fight for the truth? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
For too long, some of the most powerful people in the world have counted on their money, their connections, and their influence to keep the truth buried — to make sure the full story of Jeffrey Epstein's crimes, and everyone who enabled them, never sees the light of day.
I refuse to let that happen.
The survivors of these horrific crimes deserve justice. They deserve the truth. And they deserve to know that there are people in positions of power who will fight for them — not for the rich and well-connected who would rather this all just quietly go away.
That's the fight I'm bringing to the Oversight Committee. I've investigated Ghislaine Maxwell. I deposed Bill Gates. I've demanded answers from powerful financial institutions that looked the other way. And I am not going to stop until the full truth is out in the open, no matter how uncomfortable that truth is for the people who have spent years hiding it.
But here's what I've learned: One person can't do this alone. It takes bold leaders — people who refuse to be intimidated, who won't back down when the powerful push back, who will always choose the truth over the easy path.
That's exactly why I founded Equal Opportunity Now.
We need more leaders in office who will fight for justice, demand transparency, and hold the powerful accountable — no matter who they are. Leaders who understand that the truth belongs to the people, not to the privileged few who would rather keep it hidden.
Will you chip in $5, $25 or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect them? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Chip in today to elect bold, dynamic Democrats up and down the ballot! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
Keep an eye out for my segment on CNN with Jake Tapper. And know that whether the cameras are rolling or not, I will always fight to bring the truth into the light.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now
Visit Our Website To Learn More! [https://www.equalopportunitynow.org/]

Stock got crushed 14%, worst day in a year, and Elon Musk's net worth took an $18.6 billion haircut to $731.7 billion. They're confirming more than $25 billion in 2026 capex while robotaxi and Optimus robots remain early-stage promises. Market's done buying the story without the numbers.
* **Winners?** Shorts who timed the miss and the chip, power, and battery suppliers already collecting on the spend. Waymo gets to keep looking like the grown-up in the room with actual fleet scale.
* **Losers?** Tesla longs still pricing in a trillion-dollar robotaxi empire on a few dozen unsupervised vehicles and training robots. Musk's paper fortune and anyone who thought margins didn't matter anymore.
* **Next?** More pressure for hard milestones. Analysts already cutting targets and demanding tangible robotaxi deployments. If Cybercab and Optimus stay small while cash keeps burning, the multiple gets taken to the woodshed again.

This is the same movie we just watched with Google earlier. Beat the top line, torch cash on AI hardware, watch the stock get punished. Tesla is further out on the risk curve, the cars still fund the dream, but the dream is still mostly PowerPoint and a couple dozen robotaxis. The Street is no longer handing out free money for promises. Show real volume or keep watching the valuation get compressed. Simple as that.

Musk owns SpaceX and Musk owns Tesla. Those rumors about a tie up could be about to start floating again. If thats the endgame, buyers of both right now could look like geniuses in years to come.

* **Winners?** The ETF complex itself and any manager running pure-play AI or AI-infrastructure products. Flows follow the narrative even when the underlying names are getting smoked.
* **Losers?** Mutual-fund dinosaurs still stuck with tax-inefficient wrappers and investors who only discovered AI last November. They're the exit liquidity.
* **Next?** More product launches, more specialization into energy and power, and continued rotation from broad AI baskets into the actual picks-and-shovels that print cash.

This is classic late-cycle behavior. The underlying names can get cut in half and the ETF complex still grows because the story is bigger than any single quarterly bloodbath. JPMorgan is just confirming what the tape already showed, capital is still flowing toward AI exposure, just through cleaner vehicles. Don't fight the structure. Fight for the best structure.

# **[American Airlines is](https://substack.com/redirect/6df07cbd-c891-45d9-a80d-43d328b7ddf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[a slow bleed with better marketing](https://substack.com/redirect/6df07cbd-c891-45d9-a80d-43d328b7ddf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
American beat on the quarter, adjusted 15 cents versus 3 cents expected, revenue $16.74 billion, then cut full-year guidance to a range of a 65-cent loss to 65-cent profit. Stock dropped roughly 8%. Higher fares and solid demand couldn't outrun the fuel bill. They're still adding capacity. The gap with Delta and United is not closing.
* **Winners?** Delta and United, who already run tighter ships, and any airline with better fuel hedges or stronger premium mix. They get to watch American keep digging.
* **Losers?** AAL shareholders and management still promising a turnaround that keeps getting postponed by the same input cost. Labor is already expensive. Jet fuel just punched them again.
* **Next?** More guidance cuts across the industry if crude stays elevated, capacity discipline finally forced on the weaker carriers, and continued valuation gap between the winners and the also-rans.

Fuel is still the boss. American can talk about long-range plans and premium seats all day, but every time the oil price spikes the margin story collapses. They're expanding while the profit gap with the leaders widens. That's not a turnaround. That's a slow bleed with better marketing.

body:
Once you sign up, you’ll receive all of our Emmy award-winning coverage.
#
Hi there,
Too much of the news media caters to wealth and power. We don’t.
We’ve built More Perfect Union as an independent, non-profit newsroom to expose corporate greed and corruption in our political and economic systems.
We’re now one of the fastest growing YouTube channels in the nation – and it’s all thanks to millions of people across the country who watch and share our videos.
If you believe this moment requires a different approach to media that takes on corporate power while centering the struggles of the working class, I hope you’ll join us today.
**[Add your name to join More Perfect Union today. Once you join, you’ll receive all of our Emmy award-winning video coverage.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22923?t=1&akid=1687%2E2118727%2EdV4Bi4)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22923?t=2&akid=1687%2E2118727%2EdV4Bi4)**
Five years ago, I founded More Perfect Union with the goal of elevating the voices of working people and building power for the working class.
We were looking to fill a void in the news media industry as stories of every day people were being ignored. Major news outlets rarely cover the economic dynamics that make our society so unequal.
We wanted to take a different approach in building a video-first media organization. We didn’t launch with a lot of fanfare – we just started putting out videos focused on the stories of America’s working class.
Why video? Because the powerful emotion of our stories is best conveyed when you can see, hear, and feel it.
Our very first video featured Amazon workers in Bessemer, Alabama who were organizing to form a union. Until then, most people had never seen their faces or heard directly from them.
More recently, we’ve been devoted to documenting the struggle for local communities over oligarchy. We’re covering the rise in AI data centers to show how Big Tech companies are monopolizing land, energy, and resources at the expense of communities. subject: Legalized corruption
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Right now, members of Congress are allowed to engage in insider trading
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?refcode=em260723-1-180&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)
Friend — right now, members of Congress are allowed to engage in insider trading, which is illegal in any other situation.
That’s right, by allowing members of Congress to buy and sell individual stocks, the law currently allows our representatives to use their tenure in Congress to get incredibly rich, often making millions and millions of dollars.
Some members use insider knowledge from private or classified briefings to get ahead of the markets. Some members even invest in companies that they are tasked with overseeing on their committees. **It’s legalized corruption and an incredible conflict of interest.**
Luckily for us, Ilhan Omar leads with integrity. She doesn’t trade stocks and she doesn’t cash in on her access to power. She fights for the advancement of the working class, not her investment portfolio or her bank account.
But, given how common this problem is in Washington, Ilhan is wondering: [**Would you support legislation that would finally BAN members of Congress from trading stocks? Vote here:**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?source=em260723-1-180&refcode2=2385.791427.gYC-Jx&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)
**[YES](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?source=em260723-1-180&refcode2=2385.791427.gYC-Jx&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)**
**[NO](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?source=em260723-1-180&refcode2=2385.791427.gYC-Jx&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)**
**[I'M NOT SURE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?source=em260723-1-180&refcode2=2385.791427.gYC-Jx&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)**
When we elect our representatives, they should be working for _us_. We pay their salaries with our tax dollars after all!
But the current system introduces a real conflict between the needs of a member’s constituents and their desire to grow their personal fortune. How can we trust that someone is voting with the country’s best interests in mind, rather than their wallet’s?
It should be a given that Congress is not a get-rich-quick scheme, and it’s a sad reality that some people seem to see it as such. It degrades the entire point of public service.
[**If you agree, add your vote to Ilhan Omar’s survey today and make your voice heard. Combating corruption and abuses of power must be priority number one if we want to restore our democracy and make it work for We the People >>**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?source=em260723-1-180&refcode2=2385.791427.gYC-Jx&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)
**[MAKE YOUR VOTE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em-jul26-congress-stock-trading/?source=em260723-1-180&refcode2=2385.791427.gYC-Jx&akid=2385%2E791427%2EgYC-Jx)**
Thank you in advance for sharing your opinion.
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan

name: Team Derek Tran
subject: 🚨 Congressman Derek Tran Stands Up to Abusive ICE Detention Centers
body:
Today, I’m introducing the Private Detention Corporate Accountability Act of 2026 which would allow families of deceased detainees to seek damages

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/derektranforcongress/ice-detention-bill-newsletter?e=fa48019594)
---
| | | | |
---
| | Dear Supporter,
Following the recent brutal killings of two bystanders at the hands of ICE, I have demanded immediate answers and accountability from the Trump Administration.
Last year, when I visited the Adelanto Detention Center to conduct oversight on detainee health and safety, I was prohibited from entering. This Administration’s chaotic and haphazard immigration agenda must end.
**Today, I’m introducing the** _**Private Detention Corporate Accountability Act of 2026**_**which would allow families of deceased detainees to seek damages starting at $5 million as the result of a wrongful death in the detention center’s care.**
While Donald Trump continues running our country into the ground like one of his failed business ideas, I’m using every tool at my disposal to fight for working families and defend our communities against the thugs in this Administration.
Sincerely,Congressman Derek Tran
---
| | ###
_The son of refugees who worked hard and sacrificed for the American Dream, Congressman Derek Tran joined the Army at 18 to give back to the country that has given him so much. Wanting to continue his career in public service, he ran in California's 45th district to put people ahead of politics and protect democracy, and won. Now, he's running again to ensure everyone no matter what neighborhood they come from has the opportunity to succeed without fear of their freedoms being taken away._
_California’s 45th Congressional District remains one of the most contested battleground races in the country. Last cycle, Derek Tran flipped the seat by just over 600 votes (a 0.2% margin) in the second-closest and most expensive House race ($46 million spent) in the country. A majority-minority district, the District has the third largest AAPI population (41%) of any Congressional District, is 28% Latino, and is home to the largest Vietnamese community in the country. Following Proposition 50, this district brings in over 15,000 new Hispanic voters and over 7,000 new Vietnamese voters, and has a DPI of 52.8%._ _It includes all or part of the cities of Garden Grove, Westminster, Fountain Valley, Cerritos, Buena Park, Placentia, Hawaiian Gardens, Cypress, Artesia, Los Alamitos, La Palma, Norwalk, Stanton, Lakewood, Santa Ana, Seal Beach, and Fullerton, as well as the unincorporated community of Midway City._
_Use of Derek Tran's military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Dept. of Defense or U.S. Army._

This Administration’s chaotic and haphazard immigration agenda must end. Today, I’m introducing the Private Detention Corporate Accountability Act of 2026which would allow families of deceased detainees to seek damages starting at $5 million as the result of a wrongful death in the detention center’s care. While Donald Trump continues running our country into the ground like one of his failed business ideas, I’m using every tool at my disposal to fight for working families and defend our communities against the thugs in this Administration. Sincerely,Congressman Derek Tran | | ### The son of refugees who worked hard and sacrificed for the American Dream, Congressman Derek Tran joined the Army at 18 to give back to the country that has given him so much. Wanting to continue his career in public service, he ran in California's 45th district to put people ahead of politics and protect democracy, and won. Now, he's running again to ensure everyone no matter what neighborhood they come from has the opportunity to succeed without fear of their freedoms being taken away. California’s 45th Congressional District remains one of the most contested battleground races in the country. Last cycle, Derek Tran flipped the seat by just over 600 votes (a 0.2% margin) in the second-closest and most expensive House race ($46 million spent) in the country. A majority-minority district, the District has the third largest AAPI population (41%) of any Congressional District, is 28% Latino, and is home to the largest Vietnamese community in the country. Following Proposition 50, this district brings in over 15,000 new Hispanic voters and over 7,000 new Vietnamese voters, and has a DPI of 52.8%. It includes all or part of the cities of Garden Grove, Westminster, Fountain Valley, Cerritos, Buena Park, Placentia, Hawaiian Gardens, Cypress, Artesia, Los Alamitos, La Palma, Norwalk, Stanton, Lakewood, Santa Ana, Seal Beach, and Fullerton, as well as the unincorporated community of Midway City. Use of Derek Tran's military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Dept. of Defense or U.S. Army. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Derek Tran for Congress. | Once again, Congress can always find more money for Israel's military but not our country's basic health care needs.
Republicans in the House (along with a couple of Democrats!) just passed a $1.15 trillion defense bill that authorizes another $750 million for joint U.S.-Israel weapons and military programs, while embedding Israel even deeper into our defense technology, intelligence, and weapons-development systems.
Instead of stopping Trump's illegal war that was started for Benjamin Netanyahu, Republicans approved another $73 billion to keep that war going.
And... buried inside the bill, they snuck in Trump's voter-suppression agenda in the same legislation.
While families in Denver are struggling to pay rent, afford groceries, and see a doctor, Washington is handing hundreds of millions more to a foreign government carrying out a genocide in Gaza. Then they are making it harder for Americans to vote them out for doing it.
That is the bargain Congress is offering us. More bombs for Israel, more money for defense contractors, and fewer rights for the people footing the bill.
I refuse to accept it.
I ran for Congress to ensure we have one more vote that will stop writing blank checks to Israel, end our involvement in Netanyahu's wars, and invest our money in the working people who actually earned it.
A lot of people in Washington are hoping they can file our victory away as a one-time upset and get back to business as usual.
But what we achieved in Denver is so much bigger, and our first end-of-month deadline is a chance to show that the movement we built together is still growing, organizing, and ready to take on AIPAC, the war machine, and every politician who puts their money ahead of our lives.
[Whatever you're able to contribute today will help us keep building that power.](https://cefuo8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001sZqj-r57Jpbnm7naZQ4FHcG0LD__wtfCIXtfN7RgDsGqfZcUxZWfIyf9Z9RiTd6JhVzeTlt54T1XSpKhdI3gbKdhdbtqRVUcNNol33Cr-GeILKlL8_JwVDTPUuMyTYCviit-InszU3X5b7HKmQ7eQnHroNVDQlD0X8wF3T4-hCCREcyuI2AKTLjohNx3AbS-vhUxyFpwAY3uPnYKOcfw4SKjbakBdt4qCBphpOCmWHGsW5-kCbYstw==&c=TzLQFvuqzpBfyq9YIEyCNh7VPk3m2urH8Z2U1Czqe_fvLgmK1Nndcw==&ch=eIrLXbKCPvQcMEf0owg1CuT92UOYFlKc1GKb7J40pt8wnf1Lm9knxg==)

I've fought my entire life for the United States of America. I fought for democracy all over the world.

clean_body: More fraud under Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan | I am mad, Fellow Conservative. I've fought my entire life for the United States of America. I fought for democracy all over the world. And to learn that someone might have voted USING MY NAME while I was 2,000 miles away in SEAL training! This is a threat to our democracy. How can I be in two places at once? The answer is another fraud scandal. This time, rampant voter fraud. We can thank Governor Tim Walz and his "co-governor" Peggy Flanagan. This clearly shows that we have an election integrity issue in our state. One of the pillars and foundational principles of democracy is free, fair, and transparent elections, and we don't have any of those things right now in the United States of America. It’s time to solve the problem. 1. Show ID to vote. 2. Same-day in-person voting. The solutions are simple. But Democrats don’t want their biggest illegal voting bloc to be stopped from voting. Fellow Conservative, I want to hear from you. This is personal to me, Fellow Conservative. clean_body: We got our start here. And we’re not going anywhere. | | | Here in the South, now that the Supreme Court has greenlit racist new voting maps, we’re up against a full-on, coordinated, Neo-Confederate effort to rip representation away from Black and brown voters and cement one-party rule for the GOP. It’s a five-alarm fire. But Black leaders have warned that our region isn’t getting the resources and attention it needs: POLITICO:“Black lawmakers and activists across the Deep South argue they have been abandoned by the Democratic Party to fight an existential crisis on their own. They say they’ve been let down by nearly all corners of the party: would be-presidential hopefuls who have flocked to early and swing states but don’t bring their megaphones elsewhere; congressional leadership focused on majority-making battlegrounds while safe Black seats are drawn out; and years of chronic underfunding that has allowed local party apparatus to wither away.” = We got our start in Georgia, where it took years of grassroots organizing and sustained investments to mobilize a new electorate and make the Peach State one of the most competitive battlegrounds in the country. There’s no reason we can’t tell that same story about more states throughout the South — including Mississippi, where we are one of the main Southern organizations fighting to elect Democrat Scott Colom to the U.S. Senate. And the work goes on in Georgia, where we are in striking distance of flipping the State House from red to blue and where we’ve got huge races for Governor and Senate this year. But it’s going to take ongoing support to turn out and empower new voters, lift up the work of pro-voter allies, and elect Democracy Champions across the South. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- In solidarity, The Fair Fight Action Team | = = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2026 Fair Fight - All rights reserved. Fellow Conservative, There's a scene in the 90s classic movie _Office Space_ where two consultants — the "Bobs" — sit a guy down and ask him, flatly, what it is he actually does all day. He fumbles. Everybody in the room already knows why: he doesn't do anything, and he's about to get canned.

We'd like to ask Senate Republican leadership the same thing.

"What would you say you do here?"

Because from where grassroots conservatives are sitting, Senate leadership doesn't do much of anything.
---
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=eeffb418132849a2bad25e534d480281&_e=39JlftBWtHYxYjwKnhuGo83Vqd6Vkoklw-ehF0IDPxxR5vdyQRPeaDNO-rLDQhXZropTTL7NVWm4-EcAOQNCa82zfyphFwhe8cLDCKL047x83S31EhcUL0mNLqAIkDmzE1vZzkrK0-KecPsxe07pj0ad8mt22aYpyTkp6QI23KafGbTPTlFCS6KGi9ya5CFFPoIhpRrbIYhESvaj9FK9HuxnACPcAgSBZAVkWNWz9MwenGmVpR-ystK0M0vTfrieG1XCVYt-X7X6ZGTV6D4PqhBYa-sI4SO7mymqL7c0ZwzOm9mi7sfHTKpkniC1ZlrEKKdinajTOpkX4SW2RnlSH8As_mxrwRxm87FrJ3np8WYbCiCSopx2JHIlMwtpjbBEoX2S2zIgCrgorOnCR-7aR7rIC6VKTFLGHwmqFbabp3bYtHPnN0s47xT6j4OSa6qR)

Take the SAVE America Act. Here's a bill that simply says people should prove they're citizens before they vote. It was promised to voters in the 2024 landslide. It's championed by President Trump. It's passed the Republican House multiple times. Supporters say it would help stop voter fraud and restore trust in our elections.

And yet Senate Majority Leader John Thune won't fight to pass it. He has the tools — a talking filibuster, attaching it to a must-pass bill, including it in reconciliation — he just doesn't want to use them. Asked why, he said plainly: "It's about the votes. It's about the math."

Let's check Thune's math: ✅ Republicans control the House, 218 to 215.
✅ Republicans control the Senate, 53 to 47.
✅ Republicans control the presidency, 312 electoral votes to 226.

You'd think wins like that would be a mandate. You'd think it would buy Republicans one real legislative victory this year — something more than another pork-stuffed spending bill. But according to Thune, he's just the "clear-eyed realist about what we can achieve."

**If voters don't get anything for winning elections, what's the point of winning them?**

This is exactly why SCF doesn't sit around waiting for Washington to fix itself — we go recruit the fix. Right now, we're backing Ken Paxton in Texas, Mike Collins in Georgia, Kevin Hern in Oklahoma, Barry Moore in Alabama, and Harriet Hageman in Wyoming — candidates who didn't get into this race to explain why the fight can't be won, but to win it.

[**Support our 2026 candidates today, while there's still time!**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=eeffb418132849a2bad25e534d480281&_e=39JlftBWtHYxYjwKnhuGo83Vqd6Vkoklw-ehF0IDPxxR5vdyQRPeaDNO-rLDQhXZropTTL7NVWm4-EcAOQNCa82zfyphFwhe8cLDCKL047zyGiqlJ72B5yJB3jTRlNU4jrZM586o4yGjw9SD1YXr_-e8HnjHx3whuZHaWaALPBJdcuGUekpMGUwIor9EwQebp9Nqb7TIqjcpYl8H9eg_qtPK7NLB35CLJ8WyRPyiB3_46La6pO7de9btIfw96p4Glahaq1kDq0Bwz2QeGsiWZCH7irLRy7-7Pqi9Txrio4lHXMUXb5EDRLA0MZQygUNvn77LmowrCoXlURs6wPC183_as0IxpfawtYXI02ESvE_l5BJwlVaK7UE-1I9gGsQiNe3PtwpcmybdKic6dviTqmusj9ib0_R9I8ahQ77hsm0VSeFA9q6ni81kP_nIuHU9)
Remember the Tea Party years, when the same Republican leadership class lectured grassroots conservatives, over and over: "You can't just run against things, you have to be for something." Fine. Here's a bill that's for something — for the basic idea that only citizens decide American elections. We're for it. Are they?

Here's the part that really makes our blood boil. While establishment Senators — like John Cornyn, who deservedly lost his primary in Texas — are lecturing voters for having unrealistic expectations, they ran campaign ads all spring and summer promising to pass the SAVE America Act.

Uh, what? So we're the rubes who fell for the outrageous idea that passing the SAVE America Act was possible, while the GOP establishment ran campaign ads telling us to vote for them specifically to pass the bill. Got it.

It's the same theater we've watched for decades. Always the same routine. Always Lucy pulling away the football. Senate Republican leadership doesn't lack the votes — they lack the will. And they've gotten very good at sounding smart while explaining why the only realistic move is to break their word to voters.

Friends,
While Mike Lawler has spent the past week neglecting his job and complaining about getting more TV air time, I’ve been hitting the trail to meet voters across the district and discuss how Congress can do better for them and their families.
On Saturday, we lived by the Army saying “if it ain’t raining, we ain’t training!” Despite the rain, more than 250 public servants, union leaders, community advocates, and residents from across the Hudson Valley came out for our kick-off rally. Students, veterans, retirees, parents pushing strollers — all fed up with the dysfunction, corruption, and chaos in Washington. Voters are hungry for change. There’s no better example of this corruption and dysfunction than our own congressman, Mike Lawler, who has put profits over people time and time again. He said he'd protect our healthcare, then took $330,000 from big pharma and health insurance companies while they jacked up New Yorkers' insurance rates by 50%. He said he'd fight for our wallet, then voted eight times to protect Trump's tariffs that cost Hudson Valley families nearly $2,000 a year — calling it "a little bit of short-term pain." He said he'd lower our costs, but it turns out his real priority is the utility company friends he made as an energy lobbyist. He continues to take tens of thousands of dollars from monopoly utilities as energy bills for Hudson Valley families have gone up over 50% — nearly $1,000 more a year. And yes, you guessed it, he’s done nothing to stop it. Mike Lawler has had his opportunity to put the Hudson Valley above his own political career. He has failed, and we deserve better.

clean_body: | | | | Friends, While Mike Lawler has spent the past week neglecting his job and complaining about getting more TV air time, I’ve been hitting the trail to meet voters across the district and discuss how Congress can do better for them and their families. On Saturday, we lived by the Army saying “if it ain’t raining, we ain’t training!” Despite the rain, more than 250 public servants, union leaders, community advocates, and residents from across the Hudson Valley came out for our kick-off rally. Students, veterans, retirees, parents pushing strollers — all fed up with the dysfunction, corruption, and chaos in Washington. Voters are hungry for change. There’s no better example of this corruption and dysfunction than our own congressman, Mike Lawler, who has put profits over people time and time again. He said he'd protect our healthcare, then took $330,000 from big pharma and health insurance companies while they jacked up New Yorkers' insurance rates by 50%. He said he'd fight for our wallet, then voted eight times to protect Trump's tariffs that cost Hudson Valley families nearly $2,000 a year — calling it "a little bit of short-term pain." He said he'd lower our costs, but it turns out his real priority is the utility company friends he made as an energy lobbyist. He continues to take tens of thousands of dollars from monopoly utilities as energy bills for Hudson Valley families have gone up over 50% — nearly $1,000 more a year. And yes, you guessed it, he’s done nothing to stop it. Mike Lawler has had his opportunity to put the Hudson Valley above his own political career. He has failed, and we deserve better. With gratitude and fire, Cait Conley CAIT IN THE NEWS News 12 **Democrat Cait Conley launches campaign for New York’s 17th Congressional District The Bulwark Cait Conley: Mike Lawler Bent the Knee to Trump. clean_body: | | | South Carolina’s newest Senator is not what she seems. On July 13, South Carolina Gov. Henry McMaster appointed Darline Graham to complete the remainder of Sen. Lindsey Graham's term. Graham had never run for or held elected office. She has spent her career helping people with disabilities overcome barriers to employment. This seems like someone we need in Washington to help push legislation supporting folks with disabilities! But is she? Darline Graham said in one of her first statements as U.S. Senator: "I promise to work hard over the next several months to support the president" Let’s be clear: if you support the Trump administration, you do not support people with disabilities. Darline’s brother was one of the largest supporters of the budget bill that cut Medicare and Medicaid, and she will be no different. There will be a tough election in November, but because this will be Darline’s first election, it makes her vulnerable. He fought his way back to Congress nearly three decades later. And now, for the second time, Louisiana Republicans have drawn him out of a seat they couldn't beat him in fairly.

Congressman Fields back in 1995 on the steps of the Supreme Court fighting to keep his seat. Three decades later, they took his seat again.
MAGA couldn't defeat Cleo Fields and the Black voters he represented at the ballot box, so they rigged the map instead. This was a political lynching.
But here's why MAGA's gerrymandering will backfire: In packing his district to make it as red as possible, they bled Republican voters out of the districts next door, making those bluer and more winnable than they've been in years. Their power grab left them exposed.

Black voters and Democrats across Louisiana are fed up with watching their voting rights attacked by MAGA, and they are ready to make that anger heard at the polls. Team, There are a lot of reasons your grocery bill is so high right now—not the least, Donald Trump’s illegal, reckless war with Iran which is driving up the cost of gas and fertilizer. **But the #1 reason your grocery bill is expensive right now is that a tiny handful of corporations control our food supply.** These corporate giants use their power to raise prices, squeeze local farmers and grocers, and rake in enormous profits at everyone else’s expense. Robert Reich, our former secretary of Labor, just released a beautifully animated video talking about how we got here and how Democrats like Pat are fighting back. **You can watch the video by clicking on the image below. ** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135871386/635595077/189972799?refcode=b26_em_fr_2026.07.23_b1_prhq_30DO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85OTAyMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTI2NTM0NC1kYzg2LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ilLhXgztnMwWFSsCsnwxrfoFToYjc4hTx1RbR4eWmd0=&emci=92e9b98a-cf86-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&emdi=4a265344-dc86-f111-b337-000d3a1558ce&ceid=7377596)** Pat is leading the charge in Congress to take on monopolies in the food industry. He just introduced the Family Grocery and Farmer Relief Act, a bill which would break up dominant meatpacking monopolies and end unfair pricing practices that hurt families and box out local farmers and ranchers. But right now, Pat is facing another crucial reelection campaign. He’s going up against a Mar-a-Lago insider with far-right millionaire backers, and they’re preparing to spend big. If they flip Pat’s seat, it will be essentially impossible for Democrats to take back control of the House and pass bills like Pat’s. Team,
Despite Dan Meuser actively working against us, our communities came together and stopped two massive ICE detention centers from wreaking havoc on our towns. That was a huge victory. But the fight isn't over yet.
The federal government still owns the warehouse they bought for their Tremont detention center. It used to account for **60%** of the town's property tax revenue - **nearly $1 million a year.**
We were told that DHS would reimburse Tremont. **But Congress needs to authorize those payments, and it hasn 't.**
**[So where the hell is Dan Meuser??](https://substack.com/redirect/7ab5fb73-6228-435a-aa05-b37c1a0297d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**He pushed for this detention center and then left us holding the bag when it failed.**
A school district, a town, and a whole county are on the hook for the lost tax revenue, and he's the one with the power to fix it. But he's sitting on his hands, and he's hoping we will too.
Sorry Dan, we won't. We did what a lot of people said was impossible when we stopped these detention centers. _We won 't let Dan get away with this._
**[Chip in to help me hold Dan Meuser accountable and kick him out of Congress.](https://substack.com/redirect/7ab5fb73-6228-435a-aa05-b37c1a0297d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ FIRE DAN MEUSER](https://substack.com/redirect/7ab5fb73-6228-435a-aa05-b37c1a0297d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Our part of PA deserves so much better.
Thank you for being on this team.
- Rachel Wallace

Hi, I like to tell it how it is – and to me, there are two choices in this Senate race:
**We can either let National Republicans swoop in and buy this seat for Jon Husted** – a technically unelected senator who has fought to cut our health care, give handouts to billionaires, and make life harder for everyday Ohioans just trying to get by.
**Or, we can come together and pour _everything_ **_**we’ve got**_**into this fight to help Sherrod win** – a guy whose life’s work has been to deliver for Ohioans and ensure regular folks get a fair shot at building the future they deserve.

But it is for Lombardo, because he already told us who he answers to, and it isn't Nevada families. Nevadans deserve a fighter in the Governor's office who will fight for them, not for a deranged president. That's what this race is about, and I’m counting on your support to defeat Lombardo and flip Nevada blue. Thank you, Aaron

Buttigieg.

This month, I was proud to endorse Jocelyn Benson for governor of my home
state of Michigan. Today, I’m asking you to join me in supporting her

A lot of
attention is understandably focused on what’s happening in Washington
right now.

But some of the most important decisions affecting our lives are made much
closer to home.

Whether it's the cost of housing, access to health care, the quality of
our schools, or making government work for the people it serves, governors
have an enormous impact on the everyday realities of American life. That’s
one reason this race matters so much.

Michigan needs a governor who understands that public service is about
improving people’s lives – and who has the experience, judgment, and
determination to make it happen.

That’s Jocelyn Benson.

I've had the chance to see her leadership up close. Time and again, she
has met difficult moments with steadiness, competence, and integrity. She
has worked to expand opportunity, protect fundamental rights, lower costs
for working families, and make government more responsive to the people it
serves.

What stands out most about Jocelyn is that she never loses sight of who
the government is supposed to work for. Her focus has always been on
delivering results for Michiganders.

We cannot take that kind of leadership for granted.

And it matters especially now, when so many people are looking for leaders
who will stand up for their communities, protect what matters most, and
help build a future that is more affordable, more secure, and more
inclusive.

I’m confident Jocelyn will be that kind of governor.

But winning a race like this won't be simple. Republicans and outside

Hi friend,

While the results in this race weren’t what we hoped for, I’m still incredibly proud of the campaign we built.

So, to every volunteer who knocked on a door in triple-digit heat, every supporter who chipped in when things were tight, and the incredible team who worked around the clock to build something real in this district — I want to say thank you.

We built a campaign focused on the issues that actually matter to Arizonans: lowering costs, taking on corporate consolidation, protecting our water, and cleaning up the corruption in Washington.

As the daughter of Cuban immigrants who came to our country believing in the promise of the American Dream, I’ve been honored to run for Congress and share my vision for the future of Arizona.

Regardless of the results, I will never stop fighting for Arizona families. I called Amish Shah to offer my congratulations on his victory, and I look forward to working with him and fighting tirelessly to flip this seat in November.

Thank you for being in this with me ❤️

Marlene
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/106088/images/Marlene.png]

About Marlene Galán-Woods
Marlene Galán-Woods is a former broadcast journalist and mother of five who has lived in Arizona for the past 36 years. Her parents fled communist Cuba looking for a better life. Their risk paid off and allowed Marlene to pursue her career as a broadcast journalist which brought her to Arizona. She met the love of her life, Grant Woods, and they raised a family together before he passed away in 2021. Marlene is running for Congress to stand up to extremists and be a voice for all Arizonans. If elected, Marlene will be the first Latina to represent Arizona's 1st district in Congress.

Even cynical. **Aly Richards is the exception.** Ten years ago, she promised to fight for more and better child care in Vermont. And after a decade of fighting for change, she delivered. She didn't just talk the talk — she walked the walk. A hundred new child care programs. Over a thousand new child care spaces for Vermont families. She engaged 40,000 Vermonters — business leaders, early childhood educators, legislators, and parents — to build a grassroots statewide movement and helped pass the most transformative affordable child care law in the country. What she did for child care, I trust her to do for housing, public safety, the environment, and health care. In all that time, this much has become clear: Politicians make lots of promises, but we rarely see those promises kept. It’s easy to become disillusioned. Even cynical. Aly Richards is the exception. A hundred new child care programs. Over a thousand new child care spaces for Vermont families. She engaged 40,000 Vermonters — business leaders, early childhood educators, legislators, and parents — to build a grassroots statewide movement and helped pass the most transformative affordable child care law in the country. My grandparents came from Eastern Europe to find opportunity and a better life. My parents were proud first-generation Americans. With the help of the GI Bill, my dad went to night school and was the first in his family to earn a college degree.
[**My parents believed in hard work and being involved in our community — and they encouraged us to follow our dreams.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135872214/635597729/-16634283?refcode=email_072326_biorevamp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmU0YWIyZC1lMDg2LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U1KrHgrgYMeZ0C5ct077xtZr4Zjz84ctvz2GQ4kLNQ4=)
So, in 1987, I moved to Oregon, where I found a place where I could truly be myself. I fell in love with the beauty of the state and the openness of the people.
My advocacy career began at Oregon Food Bank, where I learned that service means listening first. I traveled across Oregon, hearing from families who needed emergency food boxes to put food on the table.
[**What they shared was never just about food. It was about low wages, the cost of housing, and the burden of medical debt. These stories have been my guiding light ever since.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135872216/635597731/-16634283?refcode=email_072326_biorevamp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmU0YWIyZC1lMDg2LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U1KrHgrgYMeZ0C5ct077xtZr4Zjz84ctvz2GQ4kLNQ4=)
Those stories are why I got into public service and why, in my first term as Governor, I visited all of Oregon’s 36 counties. I wanted to hear directly from Oregonians across our state, regardless of who they voted for or how much money they make.
When I go to work every day, I think about what I heard from families who are too often ignored by politicians, and I strive to improve our state government to work for everyone.
**[Together, we’re moving Oregon in the right direction. But progress requires persistence. It takes strong leadership to confront the challenges — and the attacks — our state faces.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/135872218/635597733/-16634283?refcode=email_072326_biorevamp&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmU0YWIyZC1lMDg2LWYxMTEtYjMzNy0wMDBkM2ExNTU4Y2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=U1KrHgrgYMeZ0C5ct077xtZr4Zjz84ctvz2GQ4kLNQ4=) **
As I’m writing this, my opponent is raising millions to launch smear attacks against me and undo our progress.
The latest reports show our race is tilting away from us, so it’s going to take everyone — including you — to reverse this trend and help keep Oregon blue.
[**Everything families have shared with me is on the ballot this November. That’s why we can’t take this race for granted. Whether you’re in Seattle or across the country, there’s a way to get involved.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260723-6503-footer&t=1&akid=6503%2E420207%2EkAdzZR)
Peter,
Summer is here, and the weather couldn't be better for organizing!
Our volunteers have been hitting the streets, making calls, and having conversations with voters across our communities—all because they believe in building a stronger, more progressive future.
**So far this year, we’ve held 15 events, made almost 21,000 phone calls, and sent over 174,000 texts** to help get out the vote for progressive candidates across King County and the country! But we’re not done yet!

Stop the Sell-Off of Chaco Canyon!

The Trump administration is seeking to sell off over 330,000 acres around Chaco
Culture National Historic Park for oil and gas leasing. We need to stop this sell-off, but we only have until July 29th to make our voices heard. Add your name today to protect Chaco Canyon. https://links.messages.lcv.

Opening this region to oil and gas development would have devastating
consequences. Chaco Culture National Historic Park is a UNESCO World Heritage
Site, and the Greater Chaco Canyon region is the ancestral home of the Pueblo
people, and a site of deep cultural, archeological, and historical significance
to dozens of Tribal Nations throughout the Southwest. These lands must remain
protected.

Join LCV in standing with the local communities who have led the fight to
protect Chaco Canyon for decades. #
Peter,
We only have two weeks until Justin J. Pearson’s primary election in Tennessee's 9th — and Republicans thought they could draw his community off the map before he ever got this far.
_They were wrong._
They gerrymandered away the last majority-Black district in Tennessee. They watched the longtime incumbent throw in the towel rather than fight the new lines. And they figured that would be the end of it.
**Instead, it cleared the way for Justin J. Pearson — who already beat them once on the floor of the Tennessee House — to run for Congress.**
14 days from now, Justin has the chance to win his primary. And the second he does, the full Tennessee GOP machine will do, say, and spend whatever they can to stop him from prevailing in November’s general election.
**[Justin needs to be ready for that fight before it starts. Split a $10 donation to his campaign and Justice Democrats right now to make sure he has what he needs to win.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260723-2-jp.dT8VXm&refcode=em20260723-38072&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=2&akid=38072%2E1203867%2EC8VK8K)**
**[Contribute ››](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260723-2-jp.dT8VXm&refcode=em20260723-38072&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=3&akid=38072%2E1203867%2EC8VK8K)**
Here’s who the GOP is up against: **a member of the Tennessee Three who was expelled from the state legislature simply for standing with his constituents — and got reelected almost immediately.**
Justin doesn't scare easily, and he’ll give it his all in Congress to deliver for the working class. He’s running for Medicare for All. A minimum wage people can actually live on. A halt to AI data centers poisoning our air and guzzling power and water while rents climb. Justice for communities that have been treated as sacrifice zones for generations.
And he's running the way every Justice Democrat runs: _zero corporate PAC money, zero AIPAC money, funded by people, not lobbyists._
Tennessee Republicans tried erasing this district to expand their grip on power — we can’t let them succeed. **With just 14 days left, Justin needs every ounce of support to reach as many voters as possible before folks in Memphis head to the polls.**
**[Will you split $10 between Justin’s campaign and Justice Democrats today to help get his message out there before the primary?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260723-2-jp.dT8VXm&refcode=em20260723-38072&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=4&akid=38072%2E1203867%2EC8VK8K)**

In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Can I get your input?

body:
Take my two-minute survey.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2969%2E4032634%2E67DHzM)
---
Earlier this month, something extraordinary happened: Congress came together to pass my ROAD to Housing Act to make housing more affordable. It's proof that even in a divided Washington, progress is still possible — if we fight hard for it. Now we have to keep that momentum going. November is around the corner, and Democrats have the chance to take back our majorities in Congress and get even more done for working people. So I want to hear directly from you: What do you want Congress to tackle next? What's weighing on you and your family right now? What change would make the biggest difference in your life? [**Please take two minutes to fill out this survey. Your responses help shape the priorities I fight for in the Senate and the issues our movement puts front and center.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-survey26/?source=EW_EMZ32N_SUR_ENG_20260723_F&t=8&akid=2969%2E4032634%2E67DHzM) | [**TAKE SURVEY**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-survey26/?source=EW_EMZ32N_SUR_ENG_20260723_F&t=9&akid=2969%2E4032634%2E67DHzM)
---
Every response helps my team better understand what matters most to the people we're fighting for — not the special interests or corporations with the loudest voices, but the grassroots supporters who make this work possible.
We proved this month that when people organize and speak up, we can get real results. Now let's make sure we're fighting for what matters most as we head toward the midterms.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

I’m Troy Jackson, a fifth-generation logger from Allagash and former Maine Senate President who’s never backed down from the fight for the working class — and I’m not about to start now.
I’m proud that during my time in the Maine legislature, we made this state a better, fairer, and more affordable place for families to live and work. We protected union jobs, passed universal school meals, expanded rural health care access, and put in place some of the country’s strongest reproductive freedom rights.
_That fight must now go to the U.S. Senate._
For nearly three decades, Susan Collins has been one of the most powerful people in the country, and she has used that power to betray working people — over and over and over again.
She was the deciding vote on Trump’s tax cuts for billionaires back in 2017. Less than a year later, she was a pivotal vote in Brett Kavanaugh’s confirmation to the Supreme Court. She voted to increase ICE funding. She’s voted against organized labor, against reproductive freedom, against campaign finance reform, against environmental safeguards, and against affordable healthcare.
And of course, she votes with Donald Trump’s agenda 95% of the time.
**Flipping this seat has to be our #1 priority every single day between now and November. If you’re with me, I need you to step up.**

Jen isn't just another politician. She's a former Navy helicopter pilot who spent years flying missions and serving our nation.
After her service in the Navy, Jen continued to serve her community as an Adult-Geriatric Primary Care Nurse Practitioner.
Jen felt the call to serve in Congress after watching how Democrats in Washington ultimately failed to serve: she couldn't sit on the sidelines anymore.

| | **_Meet Rob:_** Born and raised in Kingston, PA, Rob Bresnahan is currently serving his first term as PA-08’s homegrown Congressman. He’s a fifth-generation Northeastern Pennsylvanian, and the only representative in Congress who is part of the National Electrical Contractors Association. A product of the American Dream, Rob learned the true meaning of hard work by getting his hands dirty early and often. He wired junction boxes, ran heavy equipment, drove trucks, and learned the value of an honest day’s work in the process. His family instilled the values of hard work, discipline, and perseverance in him at a young age – and Rob has stayed true to these foundational values all his life. At just 19 years old, Rob joined his family’s business as the CFO for Kuharchik Construction. He became the CEO of the company in 2013. Rob spent over a decade working and connecting with blue-collar Americans across the country before running for Congress in 2024. He was outspent 2:1 in his race against a 12-year Democrat that year, but the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania demanded change when they sent Rob to be their fighter in Washington. Through his experience as an electrical contractor, Rob saw the real world struggles facing America’s blue-collar workers first hand. Wages are not keeping up with the skyrocketing cost of living, and Americans who wake up every day and pay their dues are being left out to dry by their elected officials. But Rob’s voting record in Congress tells a different story. He’s stood up for hardworking Americans at every opportunity, regardless of partisan politics. Simply put, Rob Bresnahan brings both insight and candid concern for blue-collar America to Congress that your run-of-the-mill representatives don’t. Every day that he steps foot on Capitol Hill, Rob is 100% devoted to restoring America’s energy independence, deregulating the economy, and bringing well-paying jobs back to the great commonwealth of Pennsylvania. While he’s still serving his freshman term in Congress, Rob has already introduced key legislation to re-invest in American trades and pave avenues to success for young people who forgo a traditional college education. Now running for re-election in one of the most pivotal battleground races in the country, Rob is stepping up to the plate once again to deliver for the people of PA-08 and preserve our Republican House majority for the remainder of President Trump’s second term.

name: Voto Latino
subject: Latinos were deceived in 2024
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
The economy.
#
Peter,
Ask almost any Latino anywhere in the country what’s one of the issues that matters most right now, and you’ll hear the same answer every time — **the economy**.
In 2024, Donald Trump campaigned on lowering costs, and many Latino voters hoped for real relief.
Instead, our community was tricked. Groceries are way too expensive, rent keeps going up, and healthcare is an afterthought. Some people have been completely avoiding seeking healthcare because they simply can’t afford it.
_This shouldn’t be happening, Peter,_ which is why we need to do something about it.
We have the choice this November to elect leaders who are going to actually address the affordability crisis going on in our country. But we’re going to need the resources to do so.
[**Peter, rush in a $3 donation today to help power Voto Latino’s work to engage voters ahead of November and elect leaders who will fight for an economy that works for our community.**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260723-1.7BWiBF&amount=3&refcode=em20260723-411&t=1&akid=411%2E1366028%2ELbR8TN)
Trump broke his promises to our community, Peter. Now, as politicians scramble for control of Congress, Latino voters are ready to demand better.
That’s why we’re running ads — [**like this one**](https://act.votolatino.org/go/435?t=2&akid=411%2E1366028%2ELbR8TN) — on the economy across the country to hold Donald Trump and Republicans accountable for creating an economic crisis.
**From tight House races in California and Texas to Pennsylvania and New York, our votes will determine who holds the majority.**
Latinos have the power to decide the midterms — but only if we organize right now.
**[If you’re able, will you donate $3 right now to power Voto Latino’s voter registration and outreach work in key battleground states?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260723-1.7BWiBF&amount=3&refcode=em20260723-411&t=3&akid=411%2E1366028%2ELbR8TN)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

subject: I have an important question for you today

body:
Here's who we're looking for: Veterans who served in the war with Iran. Anyone who deployed to the region since October 7, 2023.
#
Peter —
Up front: there's no fundraising ask in this email. Nothing to chip in on. I'm writing because we're trying to find people, and we can't do it without your help.
Here's who we're looking for:
Veterans who served in the war with Iran. Anyone who deployed to the region since October 7, 2023 — the Red Sea, the carrier groups, the bases that spent months taking fire. And the spouses, parents, and kids of the people who went.
If that's you, we want to know.
I'll tell you why. Everything VoteVets has ever accomplished came from veterans saying, in public, I was there, here's what I saw, and here’s why this matters. That's the only thing that cuts through in Washington. Not think tanks. Not talking heads who've never been closer to a war than a green room.
The problem is simple: we don't know who you are. This list has millions of people on it, and there's no way for us to tell who just got home. But there are big fights ahead of us, and we need your help if we’re going to win them.
[**So we're asking you to raise your hand. If you sound like someone we’re looking for, use this link to add your name so we can reach out and get in touch with you.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260723_VV_vet_recruit_em/?source=em260723-1-120&refcode2=35383.3013755.SmdoHv&akid=35383%2E3013755%2ESmdoHv)
| [I SERVED — COUNT ME IN](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260723_VV_vet_recruit_em/?source=em260723-1-120&refcode2=35383.3013755.SmdoHv&akid=35383%2E3013755%2ESmdoHv)
---
It takes about thirty seconds. We're asking where and when you served, and whether you're willing to be contacted about speaking out. Nothing more, and nothing gets shared with anyone.
And if this isn't you but you know someone it is — a loved one, a neighbor, someone from your old unit — forward this to them.
Thank you for everything you've already given.
Semper Fi,
Travis Tazelaar
Veteran, United States Marine Corps
Political Director, VoteVets

He must be removed immediately and replaced with someone qualified to lead the Pentagon. **Every day Hegseth remains in charge of the Defense Department, he puts our troops and our national security at greater risk.** [**Add your name, and demand he be removed.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1bb90ef7-02bf-44f1-9db4-72775007b894/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbca8f0fc-00c4-4be8-9f2f-52a8bbdf0daf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) This is the man who shared highly sensitive details about an impending military attack in a Signal chat that mistakenly included a journalist. He has systematically pushed out experienced generals and other senior military leaders, weakening the Pentagon and replacing military expertise with personal loyalty and political ideology. He came into the job without anything close to the experience needed to manage one of the largest, most complicated, and most consequential organizations in the world. And instead of approaching that enormous responsibility with competence and judgment, he has repeatedly behaved recklessly, created unnecessary chaos, and treated the Pentagon like his own political playground. That would be dangerous at any time. **But it is completely intolerable during an active war, when American service members are being killed and wounded and every reckless decision can have catastrophic consequences.** Our troops deserve leaders who know what they are doing. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories.
